3	limited to the task's websites, and three actions of our own:

6	  optionally open a URL first and follow a "next page" link the model names; with a `topic` the text is kept as evidence.
7	- `record`: save one fact the model read.

105	class QwenChat(ChatOpenAI):
106	    """ChatOpenAI that switches Qwen's separate reasoning pass off (browser-use already asks for its own short
107	    thinking in the reply), which roughly halves the time per step, and asks for a JSON object reply (otherwise the
108	    model sometimes answers in prose and the step fails). SWARM_BROWSER_THINKING=1 turns the reasoning pass back on."""
109	
110	    def get_client(self):
111	        client = super().get_client()
112	        if os.environ.get("SWARM_BROWSER_THINKING") == "1" or getattr(client, "_qwen_patched", False):
113	            return client
114	        create = client.chat.completions.create
115	
116	        async def create_without_thinking(*args, **kwargs):
117	            kwargs["extra_body"] = {**(kwargs.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
118	            kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})   # without it Qwen sometimes replies in prose
119	            reply = await create(*args, **kwargs)
120	            for choice in getattr(reply, "choices", None) or []:   # Qwen sometimes writes a sentence before the JSON
121	                text = (choice.message.content or "").strip()
122	                start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}")
123	                if start > 0 and end > start:
124	                    choice.message.content = text[start:end + 1]
125	            return reply
126	
127	        client.chat.completions.create = create_without_thinking
128	        client._qwen_patched = True
129	        return client

140	class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
141	    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once."""
142	
143	    async def _navigate_and_wait(self, url, target_id, timeout=None, wait_until="load"):
144	        try:
145	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
146	        except RuntimeError as error:
147	            if "timed out" not in str(error):
148	                raise
149	            log.warning("navigation stuck, stopping the old load and retrying: %s", url)
150	            session = await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=False)
151	            try:
152	                await asyncio.wait_for(session.cdp_client.send.Page.stopLoading(session_id=session.session_id), 5)
153	            except Exception as stop_error:
154	                log.debug("stopLoading failed: %s", stop_error)
155	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)

179	    page = await browser_session.must_get_current_page()

187	async def read_current_page(browser_session: BrowserSession) -> str:
188	    """Full text of the current page (see swarm.page_text). Retries while the page is still loading."""

200	def _same_site(url: str, current: str, task: dict) -> str | None:

206	async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, site_id: str = "", on_record=None, max_steps: int = 40,
207	                 hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False, stop_reserve: float | None = None,
208	                 extra_tools=None, max_actions_per_step: int = 4) -> dict:
209	    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.
210	
211	    Screenshots are off by default (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page`
212	    already reads canvas labels and hidden text. `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this many seconds left
213	    (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)`
214	    may register more actions. Pages read with a `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
215	    """
216	    records: list[dict] = []
217	    reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S if stop_reserve is None else stop_reserve
218	
219	    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
220	        records.append(rec)
221	        if on_record:
222	            await on_record(rec)
223	
224	    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit)
225	    if extra_tools:
226	        extra_tools(tools)
227	
228	    session = make_session(ctx, browser, vision=bool(use_vision))
229	    agent = Agent(task=goal, llm=make_llm(), browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
230	                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
231	                  llm_timeout=150, step_timeout=240,
232	                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""))
233	
234	    async def stop_when_out_of_time(_agent) -> None:
235	        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve:
236	            agent.stop()
237	
238	    try:
239	        history = await agent.run(max_steps=max_steps, on_step_start=stop_when_out_of_time)
240	    finally:
241	        await session.kill() if not browsers.cdp_urls() else await session.stop()   # never kill the run's browsers
242	    return {"summary": history.final_result() or "", "records": records, "steps": len(history.history),
243	            "done": history.is_done()}
244	
245	
246	def build_tools(ctx, site_id: str, author: str, emit) -> Tools:
247	    """Our actions for the browsing model: record, read_page, fill_form. `emit(rec)` receives records and pages."""
248	    tools = Tools()
249	
250	    @tools.action("Save a fact you found (kept even if you run out of time).", param_model=RecordParams)
251	    async def record(params: RecordParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
252	        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
253	        await emit({"kind": params.kind, "data": params.data, "source": params.source or url, "note": params.note,
254	                    "site": site_id, "author": author})
255	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"recorded {params.kind}")
256	
257	    async def read_one(target: str | None, params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession) -> tuple[str, str]:
258	        if target:
259	            await browser_session.navigate_to(target)
260	            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
261	        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
262	        pages = [await read_current_page(browser_session)]
263	        if params.next_page_link:
264	            for _ in range(max(0, min(params.max_pages, 20) - 1)):
265	                if await _evaluate(browser_session, NEXT_JS, params.next_page_link) != "clicked":
266	                    break
267	                await asyncio.sleep(1.2)
268	                text = await read_current_page(browser_session)
269	                if text == pages[-1]:
270	                    break
271	                pages.append(text)
272	        text = "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n".join(pages)
273	        if params.topic:
274	            title = await browser_session.get_current_page_title()
275	            await emit({"kind": "page", "data": {"topic": params.topic, "url": url, "title": title,
276	                                                 "pages": len(pages), "text": text[:10 * PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT]},
277	                        "source": url, "note": "", "site": site_id, "author": author})
278	        return url, text
279	
280	    @tools.action("Read the full text of the current page (or of `url` / several `urls`), incl. iframes, collapsed "
281	                  "sections, tooltips; optionally follow `next_page_link` through all pages; `topic` saves it as "
282	                  "evidence.", param_model=ReadParams)
283	    async def read_page(params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
284	        current = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
285	        wanted = [u for u in ([params.url] if params.url else []) + list(params.urls or []) if u][:12]
286	        targets = []
287	        for u in wanted:
288	            target = _same_site(u, current, ctx.task)
289	            if not target:
290	                return ActionResult(error=f"{u} is not on this task's websites")
291	            targets.append(target)
292	        reads = []
293	        for target in targets or [None]:
294	            try:
295	                reads.append(await read_one(target, params, browser_session))
296	            except Exception as error:      # one bad page must not lose the others
297	                reads.append((target or current, f"(could not read: {error})"))
298	        limit = PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT // len(reads)
299	        parts, memos = [], []
300	        for url, text in reads:
301	            shown = text if len(text) <= limit else \
302	                text[:limit] + ("\n[... truncated here; the full text is saved]" if params.topic else "\n[... truncated]")
303	            parts.append(f"=== {url}\n{shown}")
304	            memos.append(f"{url} ({len(text)} chars)")
305	        memo = "Read " + ", ".join(memos) + (f"; saved as '{params.topic}'" if params.topic else "")
306	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=memo + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(parts), include_extracted_content_only_once=True,
307	                            long_term_memory=memo[:600])
308	
309	    @tools.action("Fill several fields of the form on the current page at once (by label or name), handling "
310	                  "cascading selects via `apply_button`, then optionally click `then_click`.", param_model=FillParams)
311	    async def fill_form(params: FillParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
312	        from swarm.forms import fill_fields
313	        report = await fill_fields(lambda js, *a: _evaluate(browser_session, js, *a),
314	                                   [(f.field, f.value) for f in params.fields], params.apply_button, params.then_click)
315	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=report, include_extracted_content_only_once=True,
316	                            long_term_memory=report[:400])
317	
318	    return tools

1	"""Base class for site scrapers: a model-driven browse of ONE site that streams Evidence onto the blackboard.
2	
3	Subclass, set `role` ('tender' | 'spec' | 'erp' | 'mail') and `browser`, and write `goal()` (what the model should
4	find, in general terms derived from the brief; never scenario values). The site id for the role is resolved at run
5	time (datasets name their sites differently). Override `run()` for several browse passes; call `self.browse(goal)`.
6	
7	When the scraper ends (done, failed or out of time) it sets results[f"done.{role}"] so analysts waiting on it start.
8	"""
9	from swarm.agent import Agent, Phase
10	from swarm.blackboard import Evidence
11	from swarm.browser_agent import browse
12	from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
13	from swarm.extract import brief_intro
14	from swarm.sites import site_for

16	
17	class SiteScraper(Agent):
18	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
19	    role: str = ""
20	    site_id: str = ""
21	    max_steps: int = 40
22	    hints: str = ""
23	
24	    def goal(self) -> str:
25	        raise NotImplementedError
26	
27	    def login_text(self) -> str:
28	        site = self.ctx.site(self.site_id)
29	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
30	        return f"Website ({self.role}): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}"
31	
32	    def task_text(self) -> str:
33	        facts = self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
34	        known = {k: facts.get(k) for k in ("tender_reference", "tender_title", "buyer", "scenario_date", "bidder_company")
35	                 if facts.get(k)}
36	        return f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}\nKey facts: {known}" if known else \
37	            f"CONTEXT:\n{brief_intro(self.ctx.brief)}"
38	
39	    async def post(self, rec: dict) -> None:
40	        kind = f"{self.role}.page" if rec["kind"] == "page" else rec["kind"]
41	        await self.ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind=kind, site=self.site_id, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
42	                                           author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
43	
44	    async def browse(self, job: str, *, browser: int | None = None, max_steps: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> dict:
45	        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
46	        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
47	                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
48	                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
49	        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])
50	        return out
51	
52	    async def browse_until_done(self, job: str, attempts: int = 3, **kwargs) -> dict:
53	        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
54	        is already saved, while time allows."""
55	        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
56	        for attempt in range(attempts):
57	            note = ""
58	            if attempt:
59	                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})
60	                note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). Already saved: "
61	                        f"{saved or 'nothing'}. Do only what is still missing.")
62	            out = await self.browse(job + note, **kwargs)
63	            if out["done"] or self.ctx.seconds_left() - kwargs.get("stop_reserve", SUBMIT_RESERVE_S) < 120:
64	                break
65	        return out
66

content.text:
Your idea is mostly built already, so it won't make the agent faster. Screenshots are switched off: `browse()` defaults to `use_vision=False` and `TextSession` drops them (`swarm/browser_agent.py:158`). The model clicks using browser-use's indexed DOM list and reads pages through our `read_page` text extractor. I checked where the time went in the last run (`run_6d23d89bb0e28366`), and model calls are the bottleneck, not image input:

- **256 Qwen calls.** The typical call took 14 s (p50), and 12 s of that was waiting in the hosted model's queue. Queue time added up to 39 of the 70 minutes spent in calls.
- **At most 6 calls ran at once**, while the hosted limit is 32.
- **Browsers sat idle most of the time**, making 0–7 inputs per minute each. In practice each step costs about 14 s.
- **Calls are large:** about 6–18k tokens in and about 530 tokens out on average. One call ran away to 4,766 output tokens and took 101 s.

So speed comes from fewer steps in sequence and more of them in parallel. Here is what I suggest, biggest win first:

1. **Run several agents per browser in parallel tabs.** The 4-browser limit doesn't cap tabs. ERP items are now handled one at a time per browser (`agents/scrape_erp.py:89`). Two or three tabs per browser would run that queue 2–3× faster, and mail messages and spec revisions could be split the same way. We'd go from about 6 calls in flight to 15–20, still under 32.
2. **Turn on browser-use's `flash_mode=True` and cap output length.** Flash mode drops the "thinking / evaluate previous goal / next goal" fields from every reply, so replies get much shorter. A `max_tokens` cap of about 1,500 stops runaways like the 101 s call. I'd use it for the scrapers and keep full reasoning for the bid submitter, where mistakes are costly.
3. **Add helper actions so one step does more.** The model still decides when to call them, so this is allowed. Examples:
   - `login()` fills the credentials and handles the cookie wall.
   - `erp_search(terms)` opens the search popup, fills it and returns the hit table.
   - `open_and_read(links=[...])` for mail, which reads the chosen messages in one go.

   Each step removed saves about 14 s.
4. **Send less text per call.**
   - Limit how many past steps the model sees (`max_history_items` around 6–8).
   - Send only the HTML attributes it needs (`include_attributes`).
   - Lower `PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT` from 12k characters to about 6k. The full text is still saved as evidence for the analysts.
   - Keep the system prompt identical across agents so more of it is cached. Right now only 4.7k or 9.4k tokens per call are cached.
5. **Fewer retries and lower step limits.** `browse_until_done` re-runs a whole browse when the model doesn't finish cleanly. Analysts that check "is anything still missing?" could trigger a targeted browse instead.
6. **Try a fast model on our own key for navigation (optional).** It would skip the 12 s hosted queue, but it costs more in simulated money. Since ranking is cost × time, it's only worth it if the run gets much shorter, so it needs one test run to tell.

**Where screenshots still help:** pages that are pure canvas, or where clicks keep failing. That could be a per-agent fallback switch, but it's for accuracy, not speed.

I'd start with 1 and 2: they're small changes and should cut wall-clock time the most. Should I implement them and start a test run?

## Rules

Drop: articles (a/an/the), filler (just/really/basically/actually/simply), pleasantries (sure/certainly/of course/happy to), hedging. Fragments OK. Short synonyms (big not extensive, fix not "implement a solution for"). No tool-call narration, no decorative tables/emoji, no dumping long raw error logs unless asked — quote shortest decisive line. Standard well-known tech acronyms OK (DB/API/HTTP); never invent new abbreviations reader can't decode. Technical terms exact. Code blocks unchanged. Errors quoted exact.

Preserve user's dominant language. User write Portuguese → reply Portuguese caveman. User write Spanish → reply Spanish caveman. Compress the style, not the language. No forced English openings or status phrases. ALWAYS keep technical terms, code, API names, CLI commands, commit-type keywords (feat/fix/...), and exact error strings verbatim — unless user explicitly ask for translation.

No self-reference. Never name or announce the style. No "caveman mode on", "me caveman think", no third-person caveman tags. Output caveman-only — never normal answer plus "Caveman:" recap. Exception: user explicitly ask what the mode is.

Pattern: `[thing] [action] [reason]. [next step].`

| **ultra** | Abbreviate prose words (DB/auth/config/req/res/fn/impl) — prose words only, never real code symbols/function names. Strip conjunctions, arrows for causality (X → Y), one word when one word enough. Code symbols, function names, API names, error strings: never abbreviate |

| **wenyan-full** | Maximum classical terseness. Fully 文言文. 80-90% character reduction. Classical sentence patterns, verbs precede objects, subjects often omitted, classical particles (之/乃/為/其) |
| **wenyan-ultra** | Extreme abbreviation while keeping classical Chinese feel. Maximum compression, ultra terse |

84	            merged[keys[0]] += r
85	        elif isinstance(r, dict):
86	            for k, v in r.items():
87	                if k in keys:
88	                    merged[k] += v if isinstance(v, list) else []
89	                elif v not in (None, "", [], {}):
90	                    merged.setdefault(k, v)
91	    return merged
92	
93	
94	def brief_section(brief: str, *names: str) -> str:
95	    """The text of markdown sections whose heading contains one of `names` (case-insensitive)."""
96	    out, keep = [], False
97	    for line in brief.splitlines():
98	        if line.startswith("#"):
99	            keep = any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in names)
100	        if keep:
101	            out.append(line)
102	    return "\n".join(out).strip()
103	
104	
105	def brief_intro(brief: str, limit: int = 1500) -> str:
106	    """The brief up to its first second-level section: who we are and what the tender is."""
107	    head = re.split(r"\n##\s", brief, maxsplit=1)[0]
108	    return head.strip()[:limit]

18	
19	HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (the start page / menu lists the transactions for material display, "
20	         "stock overview and price conditions); a system notice or access gate after login (copy the displayed number "
21	         "exactly - read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; a slider/robot gate can be passed "
22	         "with ONE fill_form: slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and the "
23	         "confirmation checkbox, then_click the continue button); a material search help (F4) that only lists "
24	         "results for a narrow search term; records with several tabs or registers (basic data, technical data, "
25	         "planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity scales; stock per plant and per storage "
26	         "location); status codes explained in a legend or tooltip; a short session timeout - log in again when the "
27	         "login page appears. Save steps: once you have seen the links of a record's tabs/registers, read them all "
28	         "with ONE read_page(urls=[...]) call, and use the same URL pattern for the next candidate.")

30	
31	def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
32	    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
33	    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
34	    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
35	        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
36	        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
37	        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
38	        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
39	                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
40	    return list(items.values())

42	
43	def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
44	    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
45	                     f"{' (usable travel; the nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
46	                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
47	                     for r in item["requirements"])
48	    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
49	    return (
50	        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
51	        "1. Log in if needed and open the material search (search help of the material display transaction). Search "
52	        f"for {item['group'] or 'the attributes'} and read_page the result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
53	        "2. Candidates are results whose bore, pressure, mounting and certification match (the stroke may differ "
54	        "slightly; keep candidates with any stroke). For each candidate open the material record and read_page EVERY "
55	        "tab of it (technical data; planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
56	        "3. For each candidate whose status is active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
57	        "the quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); if there are several condition records, "
58	        "pass next_page_link with the exact text of the link to the next condition record so all are read. Then "
59	        "read_page its stock: open the storage-location level and the freely usable location so the quantity is "
60	        "shown (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
61	        "Do not stop after the first candidate. Finish with done listing the candidates and their status.")
62	
63	
64	async def _queue(ctx):
65	    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
66	        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
67	            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
68	            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
69	                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
70	            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
71	                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
72	            items = work_items(requirements)
73	            queue = asyncio.Queue()
74	            for item in items:
75	                queue.put_nowait(item)
76	            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
77	            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
78	            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
79	        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]

2	"""Enters the computed bid in the tender portal's submission wizard and signs it with the TAN from the webmail.
3	
4	The model drives the wizard (browser 0) from the brief's submission instructions and a table of the values to enter;
5	`fill_form` sets many fields per step. When the wizard asks for the signing TAN the model calls `get_signing_tan`,
6	which runs a short browse on the mail browser (3) to read the newest TAN mail. Runs even if earlier phases failed:
7	then every position without data is omitted ("partial submission"), the bid is still signed.
8	"""
9	import time
10	
11	from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
12	
13	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register

21	class TanParams(BaseModel):
22	    requested_at: str = Field(default="", description="when you requested the TAN (as shown), if known")

25	def bid_table(bid: dict, tender: dict) -> str:
26	    lines = []
27	    answer = bid.get("answer") or {}
28	    by_pos = {e["position"]: e for e in answer.get("positions") or []}
29	    for line in bid.get("lines") or []:
30	        pos = line["position"]
31	        if pos not in by_pos:
32	            lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: OMIT this position (use the omit/skip option for it).")
33	            continue
34	        e, disp = by_pos[pos], line.get("display") or {}
35	        req = {k: v for k, v in (line.get("configuration") or {}).items() if v} or line.get("required") or {}
36	        extra = ", ".join(f"{label} {disp[k]}" for k, label in (("base_unit_price", "base price per piece before discount"),
37	                                                                  ("surcharge_per_unit", "surcharges per piece"),
38	                                                                  ("packaging_per_unit", "packaging per piece"),
39	                                                                  ("rebate_total", "project bonus for the whole position"))
40	                          if k in disp)
41	        lines.append(f"- Position {pos}: configuration bore {req.get('bore')}, stroke {req.get('stroke')}, mounting "
42	                     f"{req.get('mounting')}, certification {req.get('certification')} -> material {e['material_number']}; "
43	                     f"quantity {e['quantity']} pieces; net unit price {disp.get('unit_price')} EUR; lead time "
44	                     f"{e['lead_time_weeks']} weeks; breakdown (optional fields): {extra or 'leave empty'}")
45	    known = {line["position"] for line in bid.get("lines") or []}
46	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
47	        if str(p.get("position")) not in known:
48	            lines.append(f"- Position {p.get('position')}: OMIT this position.")
49	    return "\n".join(lines) or "- (no position data: omit every position the form shows)"

52	@register
53	class BidSubmitter(Agent):
54	    phase = Phase.SUBMIT
55	    browser = 0
56	
57	    async def run(self) -> None:
58	        ctx = self.ctx
59	        bid = ctx.board.get("bid") or {"answer": {"decision": "bid", "positions": []}, "lines": []}
60	        facts = ctx.board.get("brief") or {}
61	        answer = bid["answer"]
62	        tender_site = await site_for(ctx, "tender")
63	        mail_site = (ctx.board.get("sites") or {}).get("mail")
64	        site = ctx.site(tender_site)
65	        creds = site.get("credentials") or {}
66	        contact = ctx.board.get("mailbox") or ""
67	        started = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC", time.gmtime())
68	        decision = answer.get("decision", "bid")
69	        goal = (
70	            f"Website (tender portal): {site['url']}\nLogin: username {creds.get('username')!r}, password {creds.get('password')!r}\n\n"
71	            f"SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS FROM THE BRIEF:\n{brief_section(ctx.brief, 'Submission', 'Abgabe') or ctx.brief[-2500:]}\n\n"
72	            f"YOUR JOB: submit exactly ONE signed bid for tender {answer.get('tender_reference') or facts.get('tender_reference')}.\n"
73	            f"Bidder company: {facts.get('bidder_company')}; VAT id (USt-IdNr.): {facts.get('bidder_vat_id')}"
74	            f"{'; contact e-mail: ' + contact if contact else ''}.\n"
75	            f"Decision: {'main offer (bid)' if decision == 'bid' else 'no bid (declaration of non-participation)'}.\n"
76	            f"Discount percent: {answer.get('discount_percent')}. Net total: {bid.get('total_display', '0,00')} EUR "
77	            f"(enter numbers in German format exactly as given here).\n"
78	            f"POSITIONS (the form may ask for them in a different order: always read which position it shows):\n"
79	            f"{bid_table(bid, ctx.board.get('tender') or {})}\n\n"
80	            "How to work: log in, accept cookies, open the tender, register interest if needed, open the bid "
81	            "submission. Close survey popups with their x button. Each step saves only with its continue/next button; "
82	            "going back clears later steps, so get each step right before continuing. Use fill_form to set many fields "
83	            "of a step in one action: for cascading selects pass apply_button (the button that applies the selection), "
84	            "set the configuration first, then material, quantity, prices and lead time, and then_click the continue "
85	            "button. Check every step's result with read_page when unsure (selects may default to a wrong option). "
86	            "Acknowledge the tender documents, but tick nothing the brief does not ask for (e.g. own terms). When the "
87	            "form wants the signing TAN, request it in the portal, then call get_signing_tan and enter the TAN it "
88	            "returns right away (a TAN is valid only a few minutes; a new request invalidates the old one). Review the "
89	            "summary and confirm the binding submission (accept the browser dialog). Finish with done once the portal "
90	            "confirms the submission; report the confirmation/receipt text.")
91	
92	        def tan_tool(tools):
93	            @tools.action("Read the newest signing TAN from our webmail (call right after requesting a TAN).",
94	                          param_model=TanParams)
95	            async def get_signing_tan(params: TanParams):
96	                if not mail_site:
97	                    return ActionResult(error="mail website unknown")
98	                mail = ctx.site(mail_site)
99	                mc = mail.get("credentials") or {}
100	                found: list[dict] = []
101	
102	                async def keep(rec):
103	                    found.append(rec)
104	                    await ctx.board.post(Evidence(kind="mail.tan" if rec["kind"] != "page" else "mail.page",
105	                                                  site=mail_site, data=rec["data"], source=rec["source"],
106	                                                  author=self.name, note=rec["note"]))
107	                job = (f"Website (webmail): {mail['url']}\nLogin: username {mc.get('username')!r}, password "
108	                       f"{mc.get('password')!r}\n\nYOUR JOB: a signing TAN for tender "
109	                       f"{answer.get('tender_reference')} was just requested (at {params.requested_at or 'just now'}; "
110	                       f"this session started {started}). Open the inbox (new TAN mails appear without searching), "
111	                       "open the NEWEST signing-TAN message for this tender, read_page it, then record kind 'mail.tan' "
112	                       "with data {\"tan\": \"...\", \"received\": \"...\", \"request\": \"...\"} copied exactly, and "
113	                       "finish with done stating the TAN.")
114	                out = await browse(ctx, job, browser=3, site_id=mail_site, on_record=keep, max_steps=10,
115	                                   author=f"{self.name}.tan", stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S)
116	                tans = [r["data"].get("tan") for r in found if r["kind"] != "page" and r["data"].get("tan")]
117	                text = f"TAN: {tans[-1]}" if tans else f"No TAN recorded. Mail agent said: {out['summary'][:300]}"
118	                return ActionResult(extracted_content=text, long_term_memory=text)
119	
120	        note = ""
121	        for attempt in range(3):           # an agent that stopped early (errors) gets another go while time allows
122	            out = await browse(ctx, goal + note, browser=self.browser, site_id=tender_site, max_steps=60,
123	                               author=self.name, stop_reserve=FINAL_MARGIN_S, extra_tools=tan_tool,
124	                               max_actions_per_step=5)
125	            await ctx.board.set("submission", {"summary": out["summary"], "done": out["done"], "steps": out["steps"],
126	                                               "attempt": attempt + 1})
127	            self.log.info("submission attempt %d finished (done=%s): %s", attempt + 1, out["done"], out["summary"][:500])
128	            if out["done"] or ctx.seconds_left() < FINAL_MARGIN_S + 90:
129	                break
130	            note = (f"\n\nNOTE: a previous attempt stopped early ({out['summary'][:300]!r}). The browser may be in "
131	                    "the middle of the wizard: check the current page first and continue from there.")

12	# takes several minutes of browser steps). SUBMIT itself stops FINAL_MARGIN_S before expiry.
13	SUBMIT_RESERVE_S = float(os.environ.get("SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S", 540))
14	FINAL_MARGIN_S = 40

17	@dataclass
18	class Context:
19	    task: dict
20	    board: Blackboard
21	    llm: LLM
22	    pool: object                      # swarm.browser_pool.BrowserPool (None in unit tests)
23	    scored: bool = False              # True in a real run (has a run token); False for local scouting
24	    t0: float = field(default_factory=time.time)

26	    shared: dict = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)   # in-memory objects agents share (queues); never dumped

28	    @property
29	    def brief(self) -> str:

33	    if not only:
34	        return classes
35	    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
36	    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]

40	    try:
41	        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
42	        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
43	    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
44	        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")

46	    except Exception as error:

"""Agent base class and registry. One agent = one file in `agents/`, registered with @register."""
import enum
import logging
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class Phase(enum.IntEnum):
    COLLECT = 1   # scrapers: read the sites, post Evidence
    ANALYZE = 2   # analyzers: turn evidence into structured facts (quantities, requirements, candidate materials...)
    VERIFY = 3    # verifiers: cross-check authority / dates / tender reference / superseded records
    COMPUTE = 4   # calculators: deterministic arithmetic, set results["bid"]
    SUBMIT = 5    # fills the configurator, signs; ALWAYS runs, with reserved time


REGISTRY: list[type["Agent"]] = []


def register(cls):
    REGISTRY.append(cls)
    return cls


class Agent(ABC):
    name: str = ""               # defaults to the class name
    phase: Phase = Phase.COLLECT
    browser: int | None = None   # index of the browser this agent drives (0-3), None = no browser

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.name = self.name or type(self).__name__
        self.log = logging.getLogger(self.name)

    @abstractmethod
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Read from `self.ctx.board`, do the work, write Evidence / results back. Raise on failure (it is logged;
        other agents carry on). Stop early when `self.ctx.time_left() <= 0`."""
"""Which website plays which role. Site ids and names differ between datasets, so the model maps them from the brief
once per run; the result is cached on the board as results["sites"] = {role: siteId}."""
import logging

log = logging.getLogger("sites")

ROLES = {
    "tender": "public procurement / tender portal: the tender, its bill of quantities, bidder Q&A, bid submission",
    "spec": "the buyer's supplier/customer portal holding the technical specification (Lastenheft) and its revisions",
    "erp": "our own ERP: materials, stock, lead times, price conditions",
    "mail": "our webmail / sales inbox: approvals, internal release mails, signing TANs",
}


async def resolve_roles(ctx) -> dict:
    """{role: siteId} for the four roles; asks the model once, validates against the task's site ids."""
    async with ctx.lock("sites"):
        known = ctx.board.get("sites")
        if known:
            return known
        sites = [{"siteId": s.get("siteId"), "url": s.get("url")} for s in ctx.task.get("access", [])]
        mapping = {}
        if len(sites) > 1:
            try:
                out = await ctx.llm.ask_json(
                    "Map each role to exactly one siteId. Reply JSON {role: siteId}.",
                    f"Roles: {ROLES}\nSites: {sites}\nBrief (start):\n{ctx.brief[:2500]}")
                mapping = {r: v for r, v in (out or {}).items() if r in ROLES and v in ctx.site_ids}
            except Exception as error:   # fall through to the single-site / partial mapping below
                log.warning("role mapping failed: %s", error)
        for role in ROLES:                # any role the model left open: a site whose id or URL names it
            if role not in mapping:
                for s in sites:
                    if role in f"{s['siteId']} {s['url']}".lower() and s["siteId"] not in mapping.values():
                        mapping[role] = s["siteId"]
                        break
        await ctx.board.set("sites", mapping)
        log.info("site roles: %s", mapping)
        return mapping


async def site_for(ctx, role: str) -> str:
    mapping = await resolve_roles(ctx)
    if role not in mapping:
        raise KeyError(f"no website found for role {role!r}: {mapping}")
    return mapping[role]

50	    if x is not None and y is not None:
51	        return x == y
52	    return norm_ref(a) == norm_ref(b) and norm_ref(a) != ""
53	
54	
55	_NONE = re.compile(r"^(KEINE?|NONE|OHNE|NICHT|N/?A|—|-|–)")
56	
57	
58	def text_equal(a, b) -> bool:
59	    """Equal after normalisation; 'none required' and 'none' count as the same (no certification)."""
60	    x, y = norm_ref(a), norm_ref(b)
61	    if _NONE.match(x) and _NONE.match(y):
62	        return True
63	    return x == y and x != ""
64	
65	
66	def merge_materials(rows: list[dict]) -> dict:
67	    out: dict = {}
68	    for r in rows:
69	        no = norm_ref(r.get("material"))
70	        if not no:
71	            continue
72	        cur = out.setdefault(no, {"material": str(r.get("material")).strip()})
73	        for k, v in r.items():
74	            if v not in (None, "", "null") and (cur.get(k) in (None, "") or k == "is_active" and v is False):
75	                cur[k] = v
76	    return out
77	
78	
79	def required_stroke(req: dict, mail: dict, current_revision: str) -> Decimal | None:
80	    stroke = num(req.get("stroke"))
81	    if stroke is None or req.get("stroke_kind") != "usable":
82	        return stroke
83	    releases = (mail or {}).get("technical_release") or {}
84	    key = norm_ref(req.get("reserve_key"))
85	    match = releases.get(key) if key else None
86	    if match is None:
87	        same_rev = [r for r in releases.values() if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current_revision)]
88	        match = same_rev[0] if len(same_rev) == 1 else None
89	    reserve = num((match or {}).get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
90	    return stroke + 2 * reserve if reserve is not None else None
91	
92	
93	def match_positions(tender: dict, requirements: dict, materials: dict, mail: dict, current: str) -> dict:
94	    out = {}
95	    for p in (tender or {}).get("positions") or []:
96	        pos = str(p.get("position")).strip()
97	        ref = next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(p.get("requirement_ref"))), None)
98	        req = requirements.get(ref) if ref else None
99	        if not req:
100	            out[pos] = {"material": None, "reason": f"requirement {p.get('requirement_ref')} not found", "candidates": []}
101	            continue
102	        stroke = required_stroke(req, mail, current)
103	        group = norm_ref(req.get("kataloggruppe"))
104	        cands = []
105	        for m in materials.values():
106	            if group and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) and norm_ref(m.get("kataloggruppe")) != group:
107	                continue
108	            ok = (same(m.get("bore"), req.get("bore")) and stroke is not None and num(m.get("stroke")) == stroke
109	                  and same(m.get("pressure"), req.get("pressure")) and text_equal(m.get("mounting"), req.get("mounting"))
110	                  and text_equal(m.get("certification"), req.get("certification")))
111	            if ok:
112	                active = m.get("is_active")
113	                cands.append({"material": m["material"], "status": m.get("status_code"),
114	                              "active": True if active in (True, "true") else False if active in (False, "false") else None})
115	        active = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is True]
116	        unknown = [c for c in cands if c["active"] is None]       # status page not read: better than nothing
117	        required = {k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "pressure", "mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe")}
118	        required["stroke"] = None if stroke is None else format(stroke.normalize(), "f")
119	        chosen = active or unknown
120	        out[pos] = {"material": chosen[0]["material"] if chosen else None, "required": required, "candidates": cands,
121	                    "reason": "exact active match" if active else "exact match, status not read" if unknown else
122	                    ("only blocked matches" if cands else "no exact match among the ERP records read")}
123	    return out
124	
125	
126	@register
127	class MaterialMatcher(Agent):
128	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
129	
130	    async def run(self) -> None:
131	        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.erp", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
132	        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "erp")]
133	        if not blocks:
134	            raise RuntimeError("no ERP pages were saved")
135	        mats, conds, stock_out = await asyncio.gather(
136	            extract(self.ctx, MATERIAL_INSTRUCTION, MATERIAL_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="materials", chunk_size=25_000),
137	            extract(self.ctx, CONDITION_INSTRUCTION, CONDITION_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="conditions", chunk_size=25_000),
138	            extract(self.ctx, STOCK_INSTRUCTION, STOCK_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="stock", chunk_size=25_000))
139	        materials = merge_materials(mats.get("materials") or [])
140	        stock: dict = {}
141	        for s in stock_out.get("stock") or []:           # one row per (material, location); a re-read replaces
142	            stock.setdefault(norm_ref(s.get("material")), {})[norm_ref(s.get("location")) or norm_ref(s.get("plant"))] = s
143	        for no, rows in list(stock.items()):
144	            free = sum((num(s.get("quantity")) or Decimal(0) for s in rows.values()
145	                        if str(s.get("usable")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")), Decimal(0))
146	            stock[no] = {"free": free, "locations": list(rows.values())}
147	        erp = {"materials": materials, "conditions": conds.get("conditions") or [],
148	               "stock": {k: {"free": format(v["free"], "f"), "locations": v["locations"]} for k, v in stock.items()}}
149	        await self.ctx.board.set("erp", erp)
150	        try:
151	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements_final", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))
152	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="mail", timeout=max(1.0, min(90, self.ctx.time_left())))  # end reserves
153	        except TimeoutError:
154	            self.log.warning("matching without final requirements or mail")
155	        mail =self.ctx.board.get("mail") or {}
156	        spec = self.ctx.board.get("spec") or {}
157	        result = match_positions(self.ctx.board.get("tender") or {}, self.ctx.board.get("requirements") or {},
158	                                 materials, mail, spec.get("current", ""))
159	        await self.ctx.board.set("materials", result)
160	        self.log.info("materials: %s", {p: (r["material"], r["reason"]) for p, r in result.items()})
161

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: tender.page (done.tender)   WRITES: results["tender"], results["quantities"]
2	"""Turns the saved tender pages into positions and Q&A records, then applies the quantity rules in code.
3	
4	results["tender"] = {
5	  "meta": {"reference", "deadline", ...},
6	  "positions": [{"position", "short_text", "quantity" (as shown), "unit", "requirement_ref"}],
7	  "clarifications": [{"number", "date", "kind", "positions": [...], "new_quantity", "withdraws": [...],
8	                      "amendment": {...} | null, "keys": {...}, "setup_fee": str | null, "text"}]
9	}
10	results["quantities"] = {position: {"quantity": int (in the position's unit), "unit": str, "basis": str}}
11	Rule: tender quantity, overridden by the latest dated clarification that changes it; withdrawn answers are ignored.
12	"""
13	import asyncio
14	
15	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
16	from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
17	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_int
18	
19	POSITIONS_SHAPE = """{"meta": {"reference": "", "title": "", "deadline": "", "timezone": ""},
20	 "positions": [{"position": "position number as shown", "short_text": "", "quantity": "as shown", "unit": "",
21	                "requirement_ref": "requirement reference as shown"}]}"""
22	
23	QA_SHAPE = """{"clarifications": [{
24	  "number": "Q&A number", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp if shown, else as shown", "question": "", "answer": "full answer text",
25	  "kind": "quantity_change | withdrawal | technical_amendment | commercial_keys | setup_fee | other",
26	  "positions": ["position numbers this answer applies to"],
27	  "new_quantity": "new total quantity as shown, or null", "quantity_unit": "unit of that quantity or null",
28	  "withdraws": ["numbers of earlier answers this one EXPLICITLY withdraws/retracts (zurückgezogen); a newer value replacing an older one is not a withdrawal"],
29	  "amendment": {"document": "", "revision": "", "requirement": "", "attribute": "", "value": ""} or null,
30	  "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": null, "packaging_tariff": null, "delivery_key": null, "setup_pool": null, "bonus_plan": null},
31	  "setup_fee": "one-off setup cost amount as shown, or null"}]}"""
32	
33	
34	def withdrawn_numbers(clarifications: list[dict]) -> set[str]:
35	    """Numbers of answers explicitly withdrawn by a withdrawal answer (a newer value is not a withdrawal)."""
36	    return {norm_ref(n) for c in clarifications if c.get("kind") == "withdrawal" for n in (c.get("withdraws") or [])}
37	
38	
39	def final_quantities(positions: list[dict], clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
40	    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
41	    out = {}
42	    for p in positions:
43	        pos = str(p.get("position") or "").strip()
44	        if not pos:
45	            continue
46	        qty, basis = to_int(p.get("quantity")), "tender"
47	        changes = [c for c in clarifications
48	                   if c.get("new_quantity") not in (None, "") and norm_ref(c.get("number")) not in withdrawn
49	                   and pos in [str(x).strip() for x in (c.get("positions") or [])]]
50	        changes.sort(key=lambda c: (to_datetime(c.get("date")) is not None, to_datetime(c.get("date")) or 0,
51	                                    to_int(c.get("number")) or 0))
52	        if changes:
53	            latest = changes[-1]
54	            qty, basis = to_int(latest.get("new_quantity")), f"Q&A {latest.get('number')}"
55	        out[pos] = {"quantity": qty, "unit": p.get("unit"), "basis": basis}
56	    return out
57	
58	
59	@register
60	class QuantityAnalyzer(Agent):
61	    phase = Phase.COLLECT        # runs as soon as the tender scraper is done, while the other sites are still read
62	
63	    async def run(self) -> None:
64	        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
65	        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "tender")]
66	        if not blocks:
67	            raise RuntimeError("no tender pages were saved")
68	        ref = (self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference", "")
69	        pos_out, qa_out = await asyncio.gather(
70	            extract(self.ctx, "List the tender's positions from the bill of quantities / position overview "
71	                              "(original tender quantities, not Q&A changes).", POSITIONS_SHAPE, blocks),
72	            extract(self.ctx, f"List EVERY bidder Q&A entry for tender {ref} (all pages). Classify each answer.",
73	                    QA_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="clarifications"))
74	        positions = [p for p in (pos_out or {}).get("positions", []) if p.get("position")]
75	        seen, clarifications = set(), []
76	        for c in qa_out.get("clarifications", []):
77	            key = norm_ref(c.get("number")) or norm_ref(c.get("question"))
78	            if key and key not in seen:
79	                seen.add(key)
80	                clarifications.append(c)
81	        tender = {"meta": (pos_out or {}).get("meta", {}), "positions": positions, "clarifications": clarifications}
82	        await self.ctx.board.set("tender", tender)
83	        quantities = final_quantities(positions, clarifications)
84	        await self.ctx.board.set("quantities", quantities)
85	        self.log.info("%d positions, %d Q&A, quantities %s", len(positions), len(clarifications), quantities)
86

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: analyst   NEEDS: spec.page (done.spec), results["tender"]   WRITES: results["spec"], results["requirements"]
2	"""Requirements of the specification revision marked current, with the tender Q&A's scoped amendments applied.
3	
4	results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}
5	results["requirements"] = {ref: {"bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind": "nominal"|"usable", "pressure", "mounting",
6	    "certification", "kataloggruppe", "pieces_per_set", "reserve_key", "revision", "amended": [..]}}
7	Numbers are plain strings without locale noise (e.g. "200"); stroke is the value after amendments (usable travel if
8	stroke_kind == "usable"; the matcher adds the end reserves from the technical release mail).
9	It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start
10	while the spec scraper finishes), then from all spec pages, then with amendments, followed by
11	results["requirements_final"] = True.
12	"""
13	import asyncio
14	
15	from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
16	from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
17	from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal
18	
19	SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
20	               "is_current": true/false}],
21	 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
22	   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
23	   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
24	   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
25	   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
26	   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
27	   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""
28	
29	NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")
30	
31	
32	def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
33	    value = to_decimal(text)
34	    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")
35	
36	
37	def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
38	    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
39	    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
40	              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
41	              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
42	    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
43	                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
44	    for c in amendments:
45	        a = c["amendment"]
46	        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
47	            continue
48	        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
49	        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
50	        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
51	            continue
52	        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
53	        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
54	    return requirements
55	
56	
57	@register
58	class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
59	    phase = Phase.COLLECT
60	
61	    async def run(self) -> None:
62	        early = asyncio.create_task(self.early())
63	        try:
64	            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
65	        finally:
66	            if not early.done():
67	                early.cancel()
68	        if not pages(self.ctx, "spec"):
69	            raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
70	        revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
71	        await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
72	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
73	        self.log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
74	        tender = await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
75	        amended = apply_amendments({k: dict(v) for k, v in requirements.items()}, current,
76	                                   (tender or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
77	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
78	        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)
79	
80	    async def early(self) -> None:
81	        """As soon as a requirement table is saved, publish a first version so the ERP search can start while the
82	        spec scraper is still finishing (the final version replaces it)."""
83	        while True:
84	            topics = " ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
85	            if "requirement" in topics or "anforderung" in topics:
86	                revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
87	                if requirements and self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:
88	                    await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
89	                    await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
90	                    self.log.info("early requirements (%s): %s", current, list(requirements))
91	                return
92	            await asyncio.sleep(3)
93	
94	    async def analyse(self) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
95	        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec")]
96	        out = await extract(self.ctx, "Extract the specification's revision list and the requirement rows (for every "
97	                                      "revision whose rows are on the pages). A revision is current only if its status "
98	                                      "says so (e.g. gültig/aktuell/current), never if superseded (ersetzt).",
99	                            SHAPE, blocks, list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
100	        revisions = out.get("revisions") or []
101	        flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
102	        flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
103	        current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
104	        rows = out.get("requirements") or []
105	        if current:
106	            rows = [r for r in rows if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)] or rows
107	        requirements = {}
108	        for r in rows:
109	            ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
110	            if not ref:
111	                continue
112	            entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
113	            entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
114	            entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
115	            entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
116	            entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
117	            requirements.setdefault(ref, entry)
118	        return revisions, current, requirements
119

1	# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: verifier   NEEDS: all results   WRITES: results["verification"] (and may correct results)
2	"""Cross-checks before computing: the tender reference (mandatory for eligibility), positions vs quantities vs
3	materials, and which inputs are missing. Plain code; it never drops positions, it only reports (and fixes the
4	reference when the brief's and the portal's agree after normalisation).

12	@register
13	class EvidenceVerifier(Agent):

16	    async def run(self) -> None:

18	        brief = dict(board.get("brief") or {})
19	        tender = board.get("tender") or {}
20	        portal_ref = strip_invisible((tender.get("meta") or {}).get("reference"))
21	        ref = strip_invisible(brief.get("tender_reference"))

23	            ref = portal_ref

25	        elif ref and portal_ref and norm_ref(ref) != norm_ref(portal_ref):
26	            issues.append(f"reference mismatch: brief {ref!r} vs portal {portal_ref!r}; keeping the brief's")
27	        if not ref:
28	            issues.append("NO TENDER REFERENCE: the bid would be ineligible")
29	        brief["tender_reference"] = ref
30	        await board.set("brief", brief)
31	        positions = [str(p.get("position")) for p in tender.get("positions") or []]
32	        quantities, materials = board.get("quantities") or {}, board.get("materials") or {}
33	        for pos in positions:

35	                issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity missing")
36	            if not (materials.get(pos) or {}).get("material"):
37	                issues.append(f"{pos}: material missing ({(materials.get(pos) or {}).get('reason', 'not analysed')})")
38	        for key in ("discount", "mail", "erp", "requirements"):
39	            if board.get(key) is None:

		"""Kill the browser session and reset all state."""

"""The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.

In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
`uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
"""
import json
import os


def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
    """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
    try:
        urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
    except ValueError:
        urls = []
    return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])


async def connect(playwright, number: int = 0):
    """Browser `number` of the run (0 is browser 1) and a page in it. Locally, a Chromium of its own."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    if urls:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
        context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
    else:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")
        context = await browser.new_context()
    page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
    return browser, page

Max {max_actions} actions per step. Each step check: did last action work? Never chain consequential action (submit, confirm, continue) behind unverified one.
Reply valid JSON only:
{{"memory": "1-4 short sentences: last step ok or failed, facts to keep, next goal", "action": [{{"navigate": {{"url": "url_value"}}}}]}}
Before done with success=true: re-read request, verify every item met, nothing invented. Unmet or unsure -> success=false."""

SYSTEM_EXTRA = """
Rules:
- Cookie walls, surveys, popups: close them, never follow their links. Session expired or login form again -> log in again (credentials in task). Error page ("erneut versuchen") -> retry few times.
- read_page returns ALL page text incl. iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels (DOM view misses these). `url`: open link + read in one step. `urls`: read several selected pages (all tabs of record, several messages) in one step. `next_page_link`: exact text of paging link -> every page of paged list read at once. `topic` (short label) when page holds facts analysts need -> saved as evidence.

async def _browser_ws(cdp_url: str) -> str:
    """The browser's WebSocket debugger URL (CDP_URLS may hold http URLs, as browser-use itself accepts)."""
    if cdp_url.startswith("ws"):
        return cdp_url
    parts = urlparse(cdp_url)
    path = parts.path.rstrip("/")
    path = path if path.endswith("/json/version") else path + "/json/version"
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        reply = await client.get(urlunparse((parts.scheme, parts.netloc, path, "", "", "")))
        return reply.json()["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]


async def _with_cdp(browser: int, call):
    client = CDPClient(await _browser_ws(browsers.cdp_urls()[browser % len(browsers.cdp_urls())]))
    await client.start()
    try:
        return await call(client)
    finally:
        await client.stop()


class Tab:
    """One tab of browser `browser`, owned by one agent (one browse() at a time). `Tab(b)` is a new tab, opened at the
    first browse(); `main_tab(b)` is the tab the browser started with. Locally (no CDP) every browse() starts its own
    Chromium, so a Tab is only a label there."""

    def __init__(self, browser: int, main: bool = False):
        self.browser, self.main = browser, main
        self.target_id: str | None = None

    def claim(self, target_id: str) -> None:
        self.target_id = target_id
        _OWNERS[target_id] = self

    async def open(self) -> None:
        """Create the tab now (before the session connects) so no other agent ever sees it unowned."""
        if self.target_id or self.main or not browsers.cdp_urls():
            return
        made = await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.createTarget(
            params={"url": "about:blank", "background": True}))
        self.claim(made["targetId"])

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the tab (never the browser's main tab)."""
        target, self.target_id = self.target_id, None
        if not target or self.main:
            return
        _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
        try:
            await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": target}))
        except Exception as error:      # already closed / browser gone
            log.debug("closing tab failed: %s", error)


def main_tab(browser: int) -> Tab:
    return _MAIN_TABS.setdefault(browser, Tab(browser, main=True))


_all_page_targets = SessionManager.get_all_page_targets


def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then tabs nobody owns (popups); never the tabs
    of other agents. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""
    targets = _all_page_targets(self)
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)

        return targets
    return ([t for t in targets if t.target_id == tab.target_id]

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: tender portal (role "tender")
"""Reads the tender: overview, bill of quantities and ALL bidder Q&A, saved as page evidence ("tender.page").
Analysts turn the pages into positions, quantities, amendments and commercial keys (agents/analyze_quantities.py).

The main tab logs in and opens the tender; then the documents (main tab) and the Q&A (a second tab, sharing the
login) are read at the same time."""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

QA_JOB = ("Open this tender's bidder questions/answers (Q&A, Bieterfragen) and read_page them with topic 'bidder Q&A' "
          "and next_page_link = exact text of next-page link, so every page read in one action. Then done.")
DOCS_JOB = ("Open this tender's documents. read_page (topic naming the document) the document(s) listing positions "
            "with quantities, units, requirement references (bill of quantities / position overview). Documents locked "
            "-> register interest first. One read per document. Then done, listing what you saved.")


@register
class TenderScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "tender"
    browser = 0
    max_steps = 28
    hints = ("Portal habits: cookie wall after login; error pages that go away on retry; survey popups and decoy "
             "'open'/'accept' links leading away (close popups with their x button); documents may need expression of "
             "interest first, may open in viewers/iframes or ZIP downloads (prefer viewer); Q&A list paged, answers in "
             "collapsed rows inside iframes; dates may be in other timezone.")

    def goal(self) -> str:
        return ("Collect tender data for the reference in context. Do NOT enter or submit a bid.\n"
                "1. Log in, accept necessary cookies, open the tender (search its reference if not listed).\n"
                "2. read_page tender overview with topic 'tender overview' (reference, buyer, deadline + timezone).\n"
                "3. Documents locked -> register interest now.\n"
                "4. Then done (other agents read Q&A and documents).")

    def required(self):
        return [(("q&a", "bieterfrage", "frage", "question"), QA_JOB),
                (("leistungsverzeichnis", "positions", "quantities", "bill"),
                 "Open this tender's documents and read_page the bill of quantities / position overview with topic "
                 "'bill of quantities'. Then done.")]

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            first = await self.browse_until_done(self.goal(), max_steps=14)
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"{self.name}.summary", first["summary"])
            # main tab: documents; new tab: Q&A (shares the login)
            await asyncio.gather(self.browse_until_done(DOCS_JOB, attempts=2, max_steps=20),
                                 self.browse_in_tabs([QA_JOB], max_steps=20))
            for keywords, job in self.required():
                if self.ctx.time_left() > 90 and not any(k in self.saved_topics() for k in keywords):
                    self.log.warning("nothing saved for %s: focused browse", keywords)
                    await self.browse(job, max_steps=15)
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set(f"done.{self.role}", True)

The signing TAN is NOT read here: the submitter asks for it when it signs (agents/submit_bid.py)."""

    "Mailbox search combines words with AND and shows limited hits: search exact tender reference plus ONE topic word "
    "at a time ('<reference> <topic>'). Search inbox AND archive folder (page through results). Look-alike references "

# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: scraper   SITE: our ERP (role "erp")
"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").

The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
While waiting, the main tab of browser 2 logs in and passes the ERP's gates. Then up to ERP_TABS workers (the main tab
plus new tabs of the same browser, which share the login) take items from a shared queue until it is empty; a worker
closes its tab when the queue is empty, so no tab sits idle. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
from swarm.sites import site_for

ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 120    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page
ERP_TABS = 5             # parallel ERP workers at most (main tab included)

HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (start page / menu lists transactions for material display, stock "
         "overview, price conditions); system notice or access gate after login (copy displayed number exactly - "
         "read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; slider/robot gate passes with ONE fill_form: "
         "slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and confirmation checkbox, then_click "
         "continue button); material search help (F4) lists results only for narrow search term; records with several "
         "tabs/registers (basic data, technical data, planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity "
         "scales; stock per plant and per storage location); status codes explained in legend or tooltip; short session "
         "timeout - log in again when login page appears. Save steps: once you see the links of a record's "
         "tabs/registers, read all with ONE read_page(urls=[...]); use same URL pattern for next candidate.")


def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
    return list(items.values())


def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
                     f"{' (usable travel; nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
                     for r in item["requirements"])
    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
    return (
        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
        "1. Log in if needed, open material search (search help of material display transaction). Search "
        f"{item['group'] or 'the attributes'}, read_page result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
        "2. Candidates = results whose bore, pressure, mounting, certification match (stroke may differ slightly; keep "
        "candidates with any stroke). Each candidate: open material record, read_page EVERY tab (technical data; "
        "planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
        "3. Each candidate with status active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
        "quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); several condition records -> next_page_link = "
        "exact text of link to next condition record, so all read. Then read_page its stock: open storage-location "
        "level and freely usable location so quantity shows (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
        "Do not stop after first candidate. done listing candidates and their status.")


async def _queue(ctx):
    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
            items = work_items(requirements)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for item in items:
                queue.put_nowait(item)
            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]


@register
class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
    role = "erp"
    browser = 2
    max_steps = 30
    hints = HINTS

    async def work(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, tab: Tab | None = None) -> None:
        """Take items until the queue is empty (or time is up); `tab` None = the main tab."""
        while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
            try:
                item = queue.get_nowait()
            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
                return
            try:   # stop browsing early enough for the matcher to extract and match before collecting ends
                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab,
                                             stop_reserve=SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_TIME_S)
            except Exception as error:
                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
            finally:
                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

    async def tab_worker(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
        tab = Tab(self.browser)
        try:
            await self.work(queue, tab)
        finally:
            await tab.close()

    async def run(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, open material search "
                                  "help of material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. done once search form open.",
                                  max_steps=12)
            queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
            extra = max(0, min(ERP_TABS, queue.qsize()) - 1)
            await asyncio.gather(self.work(queue), *(self.tab_worker(queue) for _ in range(extra)))
        finally:
            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)
