1	# Swarm guide
2	
3	One process, one asyncio loop, many agents. Agents share a **blackboard**; the **orchestrator** runs them in phases.
4	Each person owns **one file in `agents/`** (no merge conflicts); shared code is in `swarm/` (change it by PR, small).
5	
6	```
7	COLLECT (dataflow: scrapers + analysts, synchronised by done flags)  ->  VERIFY  ->  COMPUTE (plain code)  ->  SUBMIT
8	 scrapers save pages the MODEL chose; analysts turn them into results                                        enter bid, sign TAN
9	```
10	
11	## Data flow (who waits for what)
12	
13	```
14	BriefReader ──> results["brief"] (reference, scenario date, bidder, authorised senders), results["sites"] (role -> siteId)
15	TenderScraper (b0) ──tender.page──> done.tender ──> QuantityAnalyzer ──> results["tender"], results["quantities"]
16	SpecScraper   (b1) ──spec.page───> done.spec ───> RequirementAnalyzer ──> results["spec"], results["requirements"]
17	                                                        (+ Q&A amendments) ──> results["requirements_final"]
18	ErpScraper    (b2) waits results["requirements"] -> queue of catalogue groups; ErpHelper (b1) joins after done.spec
19	                   ──erp.page──> done.erp ──> MaterialMatcher ──> results["erp"], results["materials"]
20	MailScraper   (b3) pass 1 approvals/conditions/technical ──> done.mail_core, pass 2 other release mails ──> done.mail
21	                   ──mail.page──> DiscountAnalyzer ──> results["discount"], results["mail"], results["mailbox"]
22	EvidenceVerifier ──> results["verification"];  BidCalculator ──> results["bid"], results["answer"]
23	BidSubmitter (b0; TAN via a short browse on b3) ──> results["submission"]
24	```
25	
26	Every scraper sets its `done.<role>` flag in a `finally`, so analysts never wait forever; every wait has a timeout
27	bounded by `ctx.time_left()`. Missing inputs degrade the bid (omitted positions, blank breakdown fields), never crash it.
28	
29	## Files
30	
31	| Path | What |
32	| --- | --- |
33	| `swarm/blackboard.py` | `Evidence(kind, site, data, source, author, note)`, `Blackboard` (post/query/set/get/wait_for/dump/load) |
34	| `swarm/agent.py` | `Agent` base, `Phase`, `@register` |
35	| `swarm/context.py` | `ctx`: `task`, `board`, `llm`, `pool`, `site(id)`, `brief`, `time_left()`, `seconds_left()`, `lock(name)`, `shared` |
36	| `swarm/llm.py` | `ctx.llm.chat / ask / ask_json` (Qwen, concurrency-limited, usage counted), `parse_json` |
37	| `swarm/browser_agent.py` | `browse(ctx, goal, browser=n, ...)`: **browser-use** on our CDP browser + Qwen, with our actions `read_page`, `record`, `fill_form` |
38	| `swarm/page_text.py` | the page extractor behind `read_page` (iframes, collapsed sections, tooltips, canvas labels, zero-width chars) |
39	| `swarm/forms.py` | the form filler behind `fill_form` (cascading selects via an apply button) |
40	| `swarm/extract.py` | analyst helpers: saved pages -> model extraction with a JSON shape (chunked, merged) |
41	| `swarm/normalize.py` | numbers (de-DE/en-US), dates (MM/DD vs DD/MM, ISO), references, German display format, cent rounding |
42	| `swarm/sites.py` | role -> siteId mapping (site names differ per dataset) |
43	| `swarm/scraper.py` | `SiteScraper`: set `role`, `browser`, write `goal()`; `self.browse(job)` for extra passes |
44	| `swarm/orchestrator.py` | discovery of `agents/*`, phases, timeouts, failure isolation, board dumps |
45	| `agents/*.py` | the agents. Header comment of each file: OWNER / ROLE / NEEDS / WRITES and the result shapes |
46	
47	## How the model browses
48	
49	The model (Qwen via browser-use) decides where to go. Three actions of ours make it fast and exact:
50	
51	- `read_page(url?, topic?, next_page_link?)`: full text of the page it chose (hidden-but-real content included,
52	  decoys hidden from people excluded); with `next_page_link` it reads every page of a paged list; with `topic` the
53	  text is saved as Evidence `"<role>.page"` for the analysts. This is "extract a selected page / paginate a
54	  model-selected result set" from the rules: the model selects, the helper extracts.
55	- `record(kind, data, source, note)`: one fact.
56	- `fill_form(fields, apply_button?, then_click?)`: many fields of a form in one step (bid configurator).
57	
58	Analysts then ask the model to extract a JSON shape from the saved text (`swarm/extract.py`) and apply the brief's
59	rules in code (latest dated record wins, withdrawn answers ignored, exact reference, authorised sender, ...).
60	
61	## Contracts (agree before changing)
62	
63	Evidence kinds: `<role>.page` (data: topic, url, title, pages, text) for saved pages; `record` kinds as the scraper's
64	goal names them (e.g. `mail.tan`). Results keys and shapes are documented at the top of each agent file.
65	Done flags: `done.tender`, `done.spec`, `done.erp`, `done.mail_core`, `done.mail`, `requirements_final`, `mail_final`.
66	
67	## Local development
68	
69	```powershell
70	atira models proxy                                   # terminal 1
71	atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression   # terminal 2
72	uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # whole swarm; dumps .swarm/board.json after each phase
73	$env:SWARM_DEADLINE_S="1200"                         # optional: simulate the 20-minute clock locally
74	$env:SWARM_ONLY="MaterialMatcher,BidCalculator"; $env:SWARM_BOARD_IN=".swarm/board.json"
75	uv run --no-sync python agent.py                     # only these agents, on a saved board (no re-scraping)
76	uv run --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -q
77	```
78	`SWARM_BOARD_IN` is ignored in scored runs. `.swarm/` holds scouting data: git-ignored, never ship it.
79	Replaying analysts on a saved board: the done flags are in the board, so waits return immediately.
80	
81	## Time budget (20-minute run)
82	
83	`SUBMIT_RESERVE_S` (default 540 s, env `SWARM_SUBMIT_RESERVE_S`): collecting/analysing stops that long before expiry,
84	then VERIFY/COMPUTE (instant) and SUBMIT, which stops `FINAL_MARGIN_S` (40 s) before expiry.
85	
86	## Fair-play rules for everyone (a reviewer reads the package)
87	
88	- No scenario values anywhere (prices, material numbers, refs, logins, TANs, totals, dates, keys, transaction codes):
89	  not in prompts, hints, defaults, tests or notes. Tests use invented dummy data. Strategy is fine, values are not.
90	- The model decides where to go and what matters. Code may parse, page through model-selected results, validate,
91	  compute, fill forms. No fixed click paths, URL lists, or crawl-everything-then-one-prompt helpers.
92	- Only the provided CDP browsers; no extra Chromium; no hosts besides the platform and the 4 sites; models via the proxy.
93	- Do not write comments addressed to the reviewer.
94	
95	## Robustness settings (learned from the first sandbox runs)
96	
97	- No screenshots per step (`TextSession`): in the sandbox they stalled every step for 30 s. `read_page` covers canvas text.
98	- No browser-use loading animation: it loads a logo from an external host the sandbox cannot reach, which left the tab
99	  "loading" and every navigation in that browser timing out. `RobustSession` also stops a stuck load and retries once.
100	- Qwen's separate reasoning pass is off and replies are forced to a JSON object (`QwenChat`, `LLM.ask_json`): steps
101	  went from 10-75 s to a few seconds and the "invalid JSON / prose reply" failures stop.
102	- Scrapers, ERP items and the submitter retry an agent that stopped early, telling it what is already saved.
103	- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.
104	
105	## Work split (3 people) and how to iterate on your part
106	
107	| Person | Agents | Iterate with |
108	| --- | --- | --- |
109	| A: tender + spec | `scrape_tender`, `scrape_spec`, `analyze_quantities`, `analyze_requirements` | `SWARM_ONLY=TenderScraper,QuantityAnalyzer` live; analysts on a saved board |
110	| B: ERP | `scrape_erp` (ErpScraper, ErpHelper), `analyze_materials` | `SWARM_ONLY=ErpScraper,MaterialMatcher` on a board that has `requirements` |
111	| C: mail + shared | `scrape_mail`, `analyze_discount`, `compute_bid`, `submit_bid`, `swarm/*` | analysts/calculator on a saved board; `tests/test_rules.py` |
112	
113	Loop: run your scraper live once -> it dumps `.swarm/board.json` -> replay your analyst on it as often as needed
114	(`SWARM_BOARD_IN`) -> check the result keys -> tune the goal/hints (strategy only) or the extraction shape -> repeat.
115	Then a sandbox test run (`atira test-run .`) to check timing; debug with `atira logs <run>`.
116	
117	## Open items
118	
119	- Tune goals/hints per site from test-run logs (`atira` MCP: `run_logs`, `run_llm_calls`, `run_screenshot`).
120	- Submitter: watch the first real runs closely (wizard order, TAN timing).
121	- Cost: browser-use sends the goal every step; keep goals short.

- Requirements are published early (as soon as a requirement table page is saved) so the ERP work starts sooner.

## Speed (each browsing step is one model call of ~14 s, most of it queue wait: fewer sequential steps = faster)

- Parallel tabs: the 4-browser limit does not limit tabs. Independent jobs run in tabs of their own (`Tab`,
  `browse_in_tabs`); tabs of one browser share its login cookies, so one login serves all. Each new tab gets its own
  window (no background-tab timer throttling) and is closed when its job ends. An agent sees only its own tab and
  unowned ones (popups), never another agent's tab. Rule: one browse() per tab at a time.
- Flash mode for navigating/extracting agents (default): replies are memory + actions only, with a compact system
  prompt (~0.6k instead of ~5k tokens) and a 2000-token reply cap. The bid submitter keeps full reasoning (`flash=False`).
- Unused browser-use actions (web search, LLM extract, screenshots, file system, uploads) are excluded: smaller schema
  in every prompt, and no wasted steps on them.
- Prompt text (goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions) is written tersely: every word is resent on every step.

class Tabs(unittest.TestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        from swarm import browser_agent

    def test_agent_sees_own_tab_first_and_never_other_agents_tabs(self):
        from types import SimpleNamespace as NS
        from swarm import browser_agent
        mine, other = browser_agent.Tab(0), browser_agent.Tab(0)
        mine.claim("t-mine")
        other.claim("t-other")
        targets = [NS(target_id=t, target_type="page") for t in ("t-popup", "t-other", "t-mine")]
        manager = NS(_targets={t.target_id: t for t in targets}, browser_session=NS(_tab=mine))
        seen = [t.target_id for t in browser_agent._visible_page_targets(manager)]
        self.assertEqual(seen, ["t-mine", "t-popup"])
        manager.browser_session = NS(_tab=None)            # sessions without a tab see everything
        self.assertEqual(len(browser_agent._visible_page_targets(manager)), 3)

content.text:
All three changes are in and the 45 unit tests pass, but nothing has run in the sandbox yet. Speed and quality are unproven until a test run.

**1. Shorter prompts** (cuts input tokens on every browser step)
- Navigating agents no longer get browser-use's built-in system prompt of about 23k characters (about 5k tokens). A short version of about 1.7k characters replaces it, with the same reply format and rules.
- I removed browser-use actions our agents never need: web search, its model-based page extraction, screenshots/PDF, uploads and its scratch file system. They no longer appear in every prompt, and the model can't waste steps on them. Web search would also try to reach hosts we aren't allowed to contact.
- I rewrote goals, hints, rules, tool descriptions and analyst instructions in short "caveman" style. All rules, traps and German terms are kept, and the JSON shapes the analysts must fill are unchanged.

**2. Parallel tabs**
- **Tab handling** (`swarm/browser_agent.py`): each `browse()` runs in its own tab, either the browser's main tab or a new one. Tabs in the same browser share login cookies, so one login covers them all. Each agent sees only its own tab plus popups, never another agent's tab. Each new tab opens in its own window, because Chrome slows down timers in background tabs.
- **Tab lifetime:** a tab closes as soon as its job ends. ERP tabs take the next item from a shared queue and close when it is empty.
- **ERP:** while waiting for requirements, the main tab logs in and passes the access gate. Then up to 5 workers on browser 2 handle the catalogue groups at the same time. Before, one worker per browser did them one after another. The `ErpHelper` classes are removed.
- **Mail:** the main tab logs in while the brief is being read. Then all topic groups are searched at once: discount approvals; condition rules plus technical release; the remaining topics two per tab, up to 3 extra tabs. `done.mail_core` and `done.mail` are still set as before.
- **Tender:** a short first pass logs in, reads the overview and registers interest. Then the documents (main tab) and the Q&A (second tab) are read at the same time.
- **Spec:** stays one tab, because each step depends on the previous one.

**3. Flash mode**
- Navigating and extracting agents now reply with a short memory plus actions only, without the separate thinking and evaluation fields. Replies are capped at 2,000 tokens, which stops the runaway replies we saw (one took 101 s).
- The bid submitter keeps full reasoning and browser-use's full prompt (`flash=False`).
- Analysts never used the model's separate reasoning pass, so they are unchanged.

**Checks:** I tested the tab handling against a local headless Chromium. Each session focused only its own tab and saw only that tab, and a closed tab reopened correctly. I also added unit tests for this, for the removed actions, and for the short prompt. `docs/SWARM.md` is updated.

**Risks to watch in the next test run:**
- About 13 browser agents now call the model at once, close to half of the 32-call limit before analyst calls are added.
- All agents run in one Python process, and browser-use processes every page on that single core.
- Without the thinking fields, the model might make more navigation mistakes. If quality drops on one site, that scraper can switch back with `flash=False`.

Nothing is committed yet. Should I commit and start a test run (`atira test-run . --follow`) once the current run finishes, then compare the two with `compare_runs`?

async def _enable_page_monitoring_routed(self, cdp_session) -> None:
    """browser-use registers one lifecycle handler per page target, but the CDP client keeps only ONE handler per event
    (the last one), and that handler drops events of every other target. With several tabs in a browser, navigations
    in all but the last-attached tab then waited for load events that never came (3-8 s per navigation). Here one
    handler per client routes each event to the queue of its own target."""
    await _enable_page_monitoring(self, cdp_session)
    events = getattr(cdp_session, "_lifecycle_events", None)
    if events is None:
        return
    routes = self.__dict__.setdefault("_lifecycle_routes", {})
    routes[cdp_session.target_id] = events

    def route(event, session_id=None):
        target = self.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if session_id else None
        queue = routes.get(target)
        if queue is not None:
            queue.append({"name": event.get("name", "unknown"), "loaderId": event.get("loaderId", "none"),
                          "timestamp": asyncio.get_event_loop().time()})

    cdp_session.cdp_client.register.Page.lifecycleEvent(route)


SessionManager._enable_page_monitoring = _enable_page_monitoring_routed


class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
    It works in its own `Tab` (set `_tab` before starting), with focus emulation on: with several windows only one has
    the OS focus, and in the others typed text and focus-dependent page scripts did nothing (logins "did not register",
    links "did not navigate"). Playwright enables the same emulation on every page for this reason."""

    _tab: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
    _focus_emulated: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)

    async def connect(self, cdp_url: str | None = None):
        await super().connect(cdp_url)
        tab, focus = self._tab, self.agent_focus_target_id
        if tab is not None and focus and tab.target_id != focus:
            alive = {t.target_id for t in _all_page_targets(self.session_manager)}
            if tab.target_id not in alive:      # a main tab's first use, or the agent closed its tab: adopt this one
                _OWNERS.pop(tab.target_id or "", None)
                tab.claim(focus)
        if tab is not None and focus:
            await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(focus, focus=True)     # turns focus emulation on for the tab
        return self

    async def get_or_create_cdp_session(self, target_id=None, focus: bool = True):
        session = await super().get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=focus)
        if focus and self._tab is not None and session.session_id not in self._focus_emulated:
            self._focus_emulated.add(session.session_id)
            try:
                await session.cdp_client.send.Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(
                    params={"enabled": True}, session_id=session.session_id)
            except Exception as error:
                log.debug("focus emulation failed: %s", error)
        return session

content.text:
The tabs are opening. Each new tab gets its own window, and the live view only shows the top window of each browser, so they look missing. The real problems were three bugs that broke agents in those extra windows, and I've fixed all three in the code. Unit tests pass, but nothing has been tested in the sandbox yet. The current run (`run_d1ee764b7577c7dc`) is still on the old code.

**What the logs show**
- The tabs do run. At about 5:30 there were 5 mail agents, 2 tender agents and 5 ERP agents working at once.
- Calls are much cheaper: about 2k input tokens per call instead of 6–18k, and a typical call took 5 s instead of 14 s.
- ERP shared the login correctly: the new tabs logged "already logged in" and went straight to work.

**Bug 1: agents in windows without focus could not type or click.**
- Only one window per browser has the operating-system focus. In the other windows, typing and scripts that depend on focus did nothing.
- The logs show it: "Login stuck 12 steps; typed values not registering", "Slider stuck at value=0", and the main tender tab saying "Clicking tender link never navigates".
- One mail tab ended with 0 records after 25 steps.
- **Fix:** every agent's tab now has Chrome's focus emulation switched on, so each page behaves as if it had focus. Playwright does the same on every page for this reason.

**Bug 2: every navigation in a new tab waited 3–8 s for nothing.**
- This is the "No lifecycle events" warning. Browser-use registers one page-load handler per tab, but the underlying connection keeps only the last one registered, and that one drops events from every other tab.
- With one tab per browser this never showed up; with several, all but one tab waited out the full timeout on each page load.
- **Fix:** one shared handler now passes each page-load event to the tab it belongs to.

**Bug 3: a tab's next job restarted from the site's start page.**
- When a tab got a second job, browser-use opened the site's start URL from the goal again. The main tender tab lost the tender page it was on, and an ERP tab moving to its next item would lose its place the same way.
- **Fix:** a tab that has already been used now continues from its current page.

**Smaller fixes**
- Mail tabs did not share the login (each new tab showed the login form), and the search sits behind a slider-and-checkbox gate. Agents looped trying to unlock it with injected JavaScript. The mail hints now say: try `fill_form` once, then press End on the slider or click its right end, and never loop on JavaScript.
- `fill_form` now also reaches form fields inside web components (open shadow roots), which the mail login and slider use. Setting a slider to "max" now sets its real maximum.

**One decision for you on visibility:** I can put new tabs in the same window instead, so they show in the tab strip of the live view. The catch is that Chrome slows timers in background tabs, which can slow pages that load or retry on a timer. With focus emulation now on, the remaining risk is mainly that timer slowdown. I'd keep separate windows; say if you'd rather see real tabs.

**Next step:** the current run will keep stalling on the mail tabs until it hits its time limit. Should I cancel it and start a new test run with these fixes?
Is it possible to put tabs alongside? Also write a small script that runs a test run, based on how you launched it previously

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Start a sandbox test run of this package (public data, unscored) and optionally follow its key log lines.

.EXAMPLE
  .\scripts\test-run.ps1                 # unit tests, then start the run; prints its id and page
  .\scripts\test-run.ps1 -Follow         # ... and stream milestones + failures until the run ends
  .\scripts\test-run.ps1 -SkipTests -Follow

  From Git Bash / a Claude Code Monitor:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/test-run.ps1 -Follow
#>
param(
    [switch]$Follow,       # stream milestone/failure lines of the run's log until it ends
    [switch]$SkipTests,    # skip the local unit tests before packing
    [switch]$Open          # open the run page in the browser
)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent)

# Lines worth seeing while a run goes: phases, scraper/analyst results, the submission, and every kind of failure.
$Milestones = 'browse done|swarm phase|site roles|brief facts|early requirements|current revision|positions,|' +

$openFlag = if ($Open) { @() } else { @("--no-open") }
$out = (& atira test-run . @openFlag | Out-String)
Write-Host $out.Trim()

def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then popups its pages opened; never another
    agent's tab or popups. A tab nobody owns and no owned tab opened (the browser's first tab) is visible only to the
    browser's main tab, which claims it. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""
    targets = _all_page_targets(self)
    tab = getattr(self.browser_session, "_tab", None)
    if tab is None:
        return targets
    mine = [t for t in targets if t.target_id == tab.target_id]
    rest = [t for t in targets if t.target_id != tab.target_id
            and (owner_of(t.target_id) is tab or (owner_of(t.target_id) is None and tab.main))]
    return mine + rest


SessionManager.get_all_page_targets = _visible_page_targets

_handle_target_attached = SessionManager._handle_target_attached


async def _handle_target_attached_with_opener(self, event) -> None:
    info = event.get("targetInfo") or {}
    if info.get("openerId"):
        _OPENERS[info["targetId"]] = info["openerId"]
    await _handle_target_attached(self, event)


SessionManager._handle_target_attached = _handle_target_attached_with_opener

The second run (`run_e05860efa33b5cc8`) finished collecting much faster, but its ERP results are wrong. I found the cause, fixed it, and started a third test run with the fix.

**Results from `run_e05860efa33b5cc8`**
- Collection finished in 7:44, against 23:45 in the run before the speed changes.
- There were no "No lifecycle events" warnings, so the page-load fix works.
- Several ERP agents ended up in the same browser tab, the one with the id ending DD39. They typed over each other ("search field kept reverting to GR-6617…", "Node does not belong to the document").
- As a result, only 1 of 5 positions got a material (01.01), and its status wasn't read; 01.02–01.05 have none. So this run is fast, but the bid will be mostly empty.

**Cause:** a tab that no agent owned was visible to every agent in the browser. That covers tabs a site opens itself (`target=_blank`) and tabs an agent opens. DD39 was one of these. The agents could see it was already logged in with the search open, so they all switched into it.

**Fix** (`swarm/browser_agent.py`):
- The code now records which tab opened which, using Chrome's own tab info. A tab another tab opened belongs to that tab's agent, and only that agent sees it.
- When an agent moves into such a tab, it becomes that agent's tab and is closed together with its main tab.
- A tab that nobody opened (such as the browser's first tab) is visible only to that browser's main agent.
- Two new unit tests cover this, and all 46 tests pass. I also re-ran the local headless check: each session still saw only its own tab.

**The test-run script** had a bug: `atira test-run` prints the run id on the error stream, which the script didn't capture. That's fixed. The third run was started with the script, so its monitor will show whether the fix works ("== run …" or "no run id").

**Runs now in progress:**
- `run_d1ee764b7577c7dc`: the first version, still running as you asked.
- `run_e05860efa33b5cc8`: now in the bid-submission phase.
- The third run, with the tab-ownership fix: its id arrives with the first monitor event.

2	"""Looks up ERP candidates for the required cylinders, saved as page evidence ("erp.page").
3	
4	The ERP only lists records for narrow searches, so the work starts once the requirements are known
5	(results["requirements"], from agents/analyze_requirements.py): one work item per catalogue group (Kataloggruppe).
6	While waiting, the main tab of browser 2 logs in and passes the ERP's gates. Then up to ERP_TABS workers (the main tab
7	plus new tabs of the same browser, which share the login) take items from a shared queue until it is empty; a worker
8	closes its tab when the queue is empty, so no tab sits idle. results["done.erp"] is set when every item has been worked on.
9	"""
10	import asyncio
11	
12	from swarm import Phase, register  # noqa: F401
13	from swarm.browser_agent import Tab
14	from swarm.context import SUBMIT_RESERVE_S
15	from swarm.scraper import SiteScraper
16	from swarm.sites import site_for
17	
18	ANALYSIS_TIME_S = 120    # what the material matcher needs after the last ERP page
19	ERP_TABS = 5             # parallel ERP workers at most (main tab included)
20	
21	HINTS = ("ERP habits: SAP-style transaction codes (start page / menu lists transactions for material display, stock "
22	         "overview, price conditions); system notice or access gate after login (copy displayed number exactly - "
23	         "read_page shows numbers drawn on canvas -, confirm, continue; slider/robot gate passes with ONE fill_form: "
24	         "slider = its maximum (e.g. 100), robot checkbox = true, then the number and confirmation checkbox, then_click "
25	         "continue button); material search help (F4) lists results only for narrow search term; records with several "
26	         "tabs/registers (basic data, technical data, planning/status with lead times; condition header and quantity "
27	         "scales; stock per plant and per storage location); status codes explained in legend or tooltip; short session "
28	         "timeout - log in again when login page appears. Save steps: once you see the links of a record's "
29	         "tabs/registers, read all with ONE read_page(urls=[...]); use same URL pattern for next candidate.")
30	
31	
32	def work_items(requirements: dict) -> list[dict]:
33	    """One item per catalogue group (or per requirement when no group is given), with the attributes to check."""
34	    items: dict[str, dict] = {}
35	    for ref, req in (requirements or {}).items():
36	        group = (req.get("kataloggruppe") or "").strip()
37	        key = group or f"req:{ref}"
38	        item = items.setdefault(key, {"group": group, "requirements": []})
39	        item["requirements"].append({k: req.get(k) for k in ("bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind", "pressure", "mounting",
40	                                                              "certification")} | {"ref": ref})
41	    return list(items.values())
42	
43	
44	def item_goal(item: dict) -> str:
45	    reqs = "\n".join(f"- requirement {r['ref']}: bore {r['bore']} mm, stroke {r['stroke']} mm"
46	                     f"{' (usable travel; nominal stroke will be longer)' if r.get('stroke_kind') == 'usable' else ''}, "
47	                     f"pressure {r['pressure']} bar, mounting {r['mounting']}, certification {r['certification']}"
48	                     for r in item["requirements"])
49	    what = f"catalogue group (Kataloggruppe) {item['group']}" if item["group"] else "these technical attributes"
50	    return (
51	        f"Find our ERP materials for {what}. Required:\n{reqs}\n"
52	        "1. Log in if needed, open material search (search help of material display transaction). Search "
53	        f"{item['group'] or 'the attributes'}, read_page result list with topic 'erp search {item['group']}'.\n"
54	        "2. Candidates = results whose bore, pressure, mounting, certification match (stroke may differ slightly; keep "
55	        "candidates with any stroke). Each candidate: open material record, read_page EVERY tab (technical data; "
56	        "planning/status with lead times) with topic 'erp material <number>'.\n"
57	        "3. Each candidate with status active/released (not blocked): read_page its price conditions with "
58	        "quantity-scale register open (topic 'erp prices <number>'); several condition records -> next_page_link = "
59	        "exact text of link to next condition record, so all read. Then read_page its stock: open storage-location "
60	        "level and freely usable location so quantity shows (topic 'erp stock <number>').\n"
61	        "Do not stop after first candidate. done listing candidates and their status.")
62	
63	
64	async def _queue(ctx):
65	    async with ctx.lock("erp.queue"):
66	        if "erp.queue" not in ctx.shared:
67	            requirements = await ctx.board.wait_for(key="requirements", timeout=max(1.0, ctx.time_left()))
68	            used = {str(p.get("requirement_ref") or "").strip().upper()
69	                    for p in ((ctx.board.get("tender") or {}).get("positions") or [])}
70	            if used - {""}:                       # only requirements some position refers to
71	                requirements = {k: v for k, v in requirements.items() if k.strip().upper() in used} or requirements
72	            items = work_items(requirements)
73	            queue = asyncio.Queue()
74	            for item in items:
75	                queue.put_nowait(item)
76	            ctx.shared["erp.queue"] = queue
77	            ctx.shared["erp.pending"] = len(items)
78	            await ctx.board.set("erp.work_items", items)
79	        return ctx.shared["erp.queue"]
80	
81	
82	@register
83	class ErpScraper(SiteScraper):
84	    role = "erp"
85	    browser = 2
86	    max_steps = 30
87	    hints = HINTS
88	
89	    async def work(self, queue: asyncio.Queue, tab: Tab | None = None) -> None:
90	        """Take items until the queue is empty (or time is up); `tab` None = the main tab."""
91	        while self.ctx.time_left() > ANALYSIS_TIME_S:
92	            try:
93	                item = queue.get_nowait()
94	            except asyncio.QueueEmpty:
95	                return
96	            try:   # stop browsing early enough for the matcher to extract and match before collecting ends
97	                await self.browse_until_done(item_goal(item), attempts=2, tab=tab,
98	                                             stop_reserve=SUBMIT_RESERVE_S + ANALYSIS_TIME_S)
99	            except Exception as error:
100	                self.ctx.board.error(self.name, f"{item.get('group')}: {error}")
101	            finally:
102	                self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] -= 1
103	                if self.ctx.shared["erp.pending"] <= 0:
104	                    await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)
105	
106	    async def tab_worker(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
107	        tab = Tab(self.browser)
108	        try:
109	            await self.work(queue, tab)
110	        finally:
111	            await tab.close()
112	
113	    async def run(self) -> None:
114	        try:
115	            self.site_id = self.site_id or await site_for(self.ctx, self.role)
116	            if self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:      # use the wait: log in and pass the ERP's gates now
117	                await self.browse("Log in, accept cookies, pass any system notice or access gate, open material search "
118	                                  "help of material display transaction. Do NOT search yet. done once search form open.",
119	                                  max_steps=12)
120	            queue = await _queue(self.ctx)
121	            extra = max(0, min(ERP_TABS, queue.qsize()) - 1)
122	            await asyncio.gather(self.work(queue), *(self.tab_worker(queue) for _ in range(extra)))
123	        finally:
124	            await self.ctx.board.set("done.erp", True)

49	        prompt = "\n\n".join([self.login_text(), self.task_text(), f"YOUR JOB:\n{job}"])
50	        out = await browse(self.ctx, prompt, browser=self.browser if browser is None else browser, site_id=self.site_id,
51	                           on_record=self.post, max_steps=max_steps or self.max_steps, hints=self.hints,
52	                           author=self.name, **kwargs)
53	        self.log.info("browse done in %d steps, %d records: %s", out["steps"], len(out["records"]), out["summary"][:300])

57	        """browse(); if the agent stopped without finishing (errors, step limit), start again with a note on what
58	        is already saved, while time allows."""
59	        out = {"summary": "", "done": False}
60	        for attempt in range(attempts):
61	            note = ""
62	            if attempt:
63	                saved = sorted({e.data.get("topic") for e in self.ctx.board.query(f"{self.role}.page")} - {None})

75	        async def one(job: str) -> dict:

name: swarm-run-findings
description: What test runs on 2026-10-10 showed about where the swarm loses data (ERP, matcher, mail duplication, logs)
metadata:

Test runs on 2026-10-10 (run_d1ee, run_e058, run_9643) all scored quality 10: decision and reference were right, and every position was omitted.

- **ERP item browses run out of 30 steps.** Each one spends its steps on login checks, the maintenance dialog, "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar", MM03 and the F4 search. A record opens only by clicking its row in the F4 list; direct /material/<no> URLs return 404. Prices and stock are almost never read.
- **The matcher drops candidates that were collected.** The F4 list has no certification, so an empty value counts as a mismatch. A requirement given as usable stroke needs the mail's reserve value, and without it nothing matches. With zero materials, BidCalculator returned no_bid (run_9643).
- **Collection ends too early.** The swarm leaves COLLECT about 8–10 min in, with lots of time left, because the agent's "done" counts as success even when its summary says data is missing.
- **Mail tabs read the same messages.** Each tab searches "<ref> <topic>", logs in again and passes the slider gate again.
- **The platform log keeps only the last ~2–3 min.** The verbose browser_use output (pydantic validation dumps) pushes out the analyst lines.
- **Flash-mode validation error.** The model puts two actions in one object, e.g. {"record":…, "click":…}.

**Why:** these points decide quality now; speed is already good (collection takes 8–10 min).
**How to apply:** fix the ERP flow (search-list stage, then per-material stage), make the matcher tolerate unknown fields, add gap-driven follow-up browses, dedupe mail reads, and reduce log noise. See [[atira-cli-path]].

content.text:
Speed is now fine: collection takes 8–10 min. The problem is quality. The last three test runs all scored **10/100**: tender reference and decision were right, and **every position was omitted**. The tab-isolation fix worked: all 5 ERP catalogue groups returned results in `run_9643`, and agents no longer type over each other. But the matcher still accepted no materials, and that run is now submitting **no_bid**.

You're right that a lot of browsing is repeated, but the bigger loss is that data we do collect is thrown away or never finished.

## Pain points

**1. ERP workers repeat the same setup and run out of steps before the useful part.**
- Each of the 5 ERP item jobs repeats the same path: login check, maintenance dialog, MM03, F4 search help, search. That costs about 10–15 of its 30 steps.
- The maintenance dialog and "Dienst vorübergehend nicht verfügbar" come back on every page load, in every tab.
- A material record opens only by clicking its row in the F4 list; direct `/material/<no>` URLs return 404.
- Agents also open candidates that the result list already shows don't fit (for example a different pressure).
- So status, prices and stock were almost never read. Agent summaries say it directly: "could NOT be opened because the step budget was exhausted…"

**2. The matcher throws away candidates we did find.**
- The F4 list shows bore, stroke, pressure and mounting, but not certification. A missing certification counts as a mismatch, so those candidates are dropped ("no exact match among the ERP records read").
- When a requirement is given as usable stroke, the matcher needs the reserve value from the technical-release mail. If that mail wasn't read, no candidate can match.
- With zero materials, `BidCalculator` sets `decision: no_bid`. That loses even the 5 decision points; a signed partial bid would keep them.

**3. Collection ends too early.**
- `browse_until_done` treats the agent's `done` as success even when its own summary says "prices/stock NOT verified".
- The swarm moved on to VERIFY at 7:44 and 9:45 with over 6,600 s of the 2-hour test-run budget left. In a 20-min scored run that would still leave about 10 min unused.
- Nothing turns the verifier's list of missing data into new browsing.

**4. Mail agents read the same messages several times.**
- Each mail tab searches `<reference> <topic>`. Most mails name the reference, so the result lists overlap and several tabs open the same messages.
- In an earlier run the discount mails were read by two browses (the analyst reported 2/2, then 3/4 valid messages).
- Every tab also logs in again and passes the slider gate again, because the login does not carry over to new tabs.

**5. Earlier ERP split (now removed).** `ErpHelper`, `ErpHelperTender` and `ErpScraper` searched the same catalogue groups (GR-6333 and GR-6617 were each searched twice). The shared queue removed that duplication, but not the repeated setup from point 1.

**6. We lose the logs that would show these problems.** The platform log for a run keeps only roughly the last 2–3 minutes of lines. browser_use's per-step output, including 50-line validation dumps, pushes out the early lines. For `run_9643` nothing before 07:37 survives, so the brief, tender, spec and mail analyst results can't be checked afterwards.

**7. Flash-mode reply format errors.** The "37–53 validation errors" happen because the model packs two actions into one object, e.g. `{"record":…, "click":…}`. Each one costs a retry call.

## Proposed solutions, in order of impact

1. **Split ERP work into two stages.**
   - Stage A, one browse per catalogue group: search and `read_page` the result list only, about 8 steps.
   - Then code compares the list rows with the requirement (bore, pressure, mounting, stroke). The rules allow this, since it filters a result set the model chose.
   - Stage B, one job per matching material, run in parallel tabs: click the row, then read all tabs, VK13 prices and MMBE stock in one `read_page(urls=[...])`.
   - No step is spent on candidates that don't fit, and each job is short enough to finish.

"""Runs the registered agents phase by phase. Agents of one phase run concurrently; a failing agent never stops others.

Time: non-SUBMIT phases are cut off when the useful time is gone (ctx.time_left() <= 0), then SUBMIT always runs.
Local dev: SWARM_ONLY=a,b runs only those agents; SWARM_BOARD_IN=.swarm/board.json preloads a saved board (ignored
in scored runs). The board is dumped to .swarm/board.json after every phase.
"""
import asyncio
import importlib
import logging
import os
import pkgutil
from pathlib import Path

import agents as agents_pkg
from swarm.agent import REGISTRY, Agent, Phase
from swarm.blackboard import Blackboard
from swarm.browser_pool import BrowserPool
from swarm.context import FINAL_MARGIN_S, Context
from swarm.llm import LLM

log = logging.getLogger("swarm")
BOARD_DUMP = Path(".swarm/board.json")


def discover() -> list[type[Agent]]:
    """Import every module in agents/ so its @register decorators run."""
    for mod in pkgutil.iter_modules(agents_pkg.__path__):
        importlib.import_module(f"agents.{mod.name}")
    return list(REGISTRY)


def select(classes: list[type[Agent]], only: str | None) -> list[type[Agent]]:
    if not only:
        return classes
    wanted = {n.strip() for n in only.split(",") if n.strip()}
    return [c for c in classes if (c.name or c.__name__) in wanted or c.__name__ in wanted]


async def _run_agent(agent: Agent, deadline_bound: bool) -> None:
    try:
        budget = agent.ctx.time_left() if deadline_bound else agent.ctx.seconds_left() - FINAL_MARGIN_S
        await asyncio.wait_for(agent.run(), timeout=max(1.0, budget))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, "timed out")
        log.warning("%s timed out", agent.name)
    except Exception as error:
        agent.ctx.board.error(agent.name, f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        log.exception("%s failed", agent.name)


async def run_swarm(task: dict, playwright, scored: bool, env=os.environ):
    board = Blackboard()
    preload = env.get("SWARM_BOARD_IN")
    if preload and not scored:                       # never replay data in a scored run
        board = Blackboard.load(Path(preload))
    ctx = Context(task=task, board=board, llm=LLM(), pool=BrowserPool(playwright), scored=scored)
    classes = select(discover(), env.get("SWARM_ONLY"))
    log.info("agents: %s", [c.__name__ for c in classes])
    for phase in Phase:
        agents = [c(ctx) for c in classes if c.phase == phase]
        if not agents:
            continue
        bound = phase != Phase.SUBMIT
        if bound and ctx.time_left() <= 0:
            log.warning("skipping phase %s: out of time", phase.name)
            continue
        log.info("phase %s: %s (%.0fs left)", phase.name, [a.name for a in agents], ctx.seconds_left())
        await asyncio.gather(*(_run_agent(a, bound) for a in agents))
        if not scored:
            board.dump(BOARD_DUMP)
    log.info("model calls: %d tokens: %s errors: %d", ctx.llm.calls, ctx.llm.tokens, len(board.errors))
    if (task.get("submission") or {}).get("kind", "api") != "api":
        log.info("answer (entered on the website): %s", board.get("answer"))
        return None                      # a "site" submission was entered by the submitter agent
    return board.get("answer")
"""Agent base class and registry. One agent = one file in `agents/`, registered with @register."""
import enum
import logging
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class Phase(enum.IntEnum):
    COLLECT = 1   # scrapers: read the sites, post Evidence
    ANALYZE = 2   # analyzers: turn evidence into structured facts (quantities, requirements, candidate materials...)
    VERIFY = 3    # verifiers: cross-check authority / dates / tender reference / superseded records
    COMPUTE = 4   # calculators: deterministic arithmetic, set results["bid"]
    SUBMIT = 5    # fills the configurator, signs; ALWAYS runs, with reserved time


REGISTRY: list[type["Agent"]] = []


def register(cls):
    REGISTRY.append(cls)
    return cls


class Agent(ABC):
    name: str = ""               # defaults to the class name
    phase: Phase = Phase.COLLECT
    browser: int | None = None   # index of the browser this agent drives (0-3), None = no browser

    def __init__(self, ctx):
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.name = self.name or type(self).__name__
        self.log = logging.getLogger(self.name)

    @abstractmethod
    async def run(self) -> None:
        """Read from `self.ctx.board`, do the work, write Evidence / results back. Raise on failure (it is logged;
        other agents carry on). Stop early when `self.ctx.time_left() <= 0`."""

125	class QwenChat(ChatOpenAI):
126	    """ChatOpenAI that switches Qwen's separate reasoning pass off (browser-use already asks for its own short
127	    thinking in the reply), which roughly halves the time per step, and asks for a JSON object reply (otherwise the
128	    model sometimes answers in prose and the step fails). SWARM_BROWSER_THINKING=1 turns the reasoning pass back on."""

136	        async def create_without_thinking(*args, **kwargs):
137	            kwargs["extra_body"] = {**(kwargs.get("extra_body") or {}), **models.NO_THINKING}
138	            kwargs.setdefault("response_format", {"type": "json_object"})   # without it Qwen sometimes replies in prose

187	class Tab:
188	    """One tab of browser `browser`, owned by one agent (one browse() at a time). `Tab(b)` is a new tab, opened at the
189	    first browse(); `main_tab(b)` is the tab the browser started with. Locally (no CDP) every browse() starts its own
190	    Chromium, so a Tab is only a label there."""
191	
192	    def __init__(self, browser: int, main: bool = False):
193	        self.browser, self.main = browser, main
194	        self.target_id: str | None = None
195	        self.popups: set[str] = set()   # tabs the page opened (window.open, target=_blank) and the agent went into
196	        self.used = False            # an agent worked here before: the next browse continues from the current page
197	
198	    def claim(self, target_id: str) -> None:
199	        self.target_id = target_id
200	        _OWNERS[target_id] = self
201	
202	    def adopt(self, target_id: str) -> None:
203	        """A popup this tab's agent focused: it belongs to this tab from now on (hidden from other agents)."""
204	        if self.target_id and target_id != self.target_id and owner_of(target_id) in (None, self) \
205	                and target_id not in _OWNERS:
206	            _OWNERS[target_id] = self
207	            self.popups.add(target_id)
208	
209	    async def open(self) -> None:
210	        """Create the tab now (before the session connects) so no other agent ever sees it unowned."""
211	        if self.target_id or self.main or not browsers.cdp_urls():
212	            return
213	        # Default: a background tab next to the others in the browser's window, so the live view's tab strip shows every
214	        # agent (focus emulation keeps typing and focus-dependent scripts working in it; Chrome only slows its timers).
215	        # TAB_WINDOWS=1: a window per tab instead (always the visible tab there, no timer slowdown, but windows hide
216	        # each other in the live view).
217	        params = {"url": "about:blank", "newWindow": True} if os.environ.get("TAB_WINDOWS") == "1" else \
218	            {"url": "about:blank", "background": True}
219	        made = await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: c.send.Target.createTarget(params=params))
220	        self.claim(made["targetId"])
221	
222	    async def close(self) -> None:
223	        """Close the tab and the popups it adopted (the main tab itself stays open)."""
224	        targets = list(self.popups) + ([self.target_id] if self.target_id and not self.main else [])
225	        self.popups = set()
226	        if not self.main:
227	            self.target_id, self.used = None, False
228	        for target in targets:
229	            _OWNERS.pop(target, None)
230	        if not targets:
231	            return
232	        try:
233	            await _with_cdp(self.browser, lambda c: asyncio.gather(
234	                *(c.send.Target.closeTarget(params={"targetId": t}) for t in targets), return_exceptions=True))
235	        except Exception as error:      # already closed / browser gone
236	            log.debug("closing tab failed: %s", error)

246	def owner_of(target_id: str) -> Tab | None:
247	    """The tab a target belongs to: its own claim, else the owner of the tab that opened it (popup of a popup too)."""
248	    seen = set()
249	    while target_id and target_id not in seen:
250	        seen.add(target_id)
251	        if target_id in _OWNERS:
252	            return _OWNERS[target_id]
253	        target_id = _OPENERS.get(target_id, "")

260	def _visible_page_targets(self) -> list:
261	    """What a session sees as "the browser's tabs": its own tab first, then popups its pages opened; never another
262	    agent's tab or popups. A tab nobody owns and no owned tab opened (the browser's first tab) is visible only to the
263	    browser's main tab, which claims it. browser-use derives its tab list, focus and new-tab reuse from this."""
264	    targets = _all_page_targets(self)

269	    rest = [t for t in targets if t.target_id != tab.target_id
270	            and (owner_of(t.target_id) is tab or (owner_of(t.target_id) is None and tab.main))]

291	async def _enable_page_monitoring_routed(self, cdp_session) -> None:
292	    """browser-use registers one lifecycle handler per page target, but the CDP client keeps only ONE handler per event
293	    (the last one), and that handler drops events of every other target. With several tabs in a browser, navigations
294	    in all but the last-attached tab then waited for load events that never came (3-8 s per navigation). Here one
295	    handler per client routes each event to the queue of its own target."""
296	    await _enable_page_monitoring(self, cdp_session)
297	    events = getattr(cdp_session, "_lifecycle_events", None)
298	    if events is None:
299	        return
300	    routes = self.__dict__.setdefault("_lifecycle_routes", {})
301	    routes[cdp_session.target_id] = events
302	
303	    def route(event, session_id=None):
304	        target = self.get_target_id_from_session_id(session_id) if session_id else None
305	        queue = routes.get(target)
306	        if queue is not None:
307	            queue.append({"name": event.get("name", "unknown"), "loaderId": event.get("loaderId", "none"),
308	                          "timestamp": asyncio.get_event_loop().time()})
309	
310	    cdp_session.cdp_client.register.Page.lifecycleEvent(route)

316	class RobustSession(BrowserSession):
317	    """A BrowserSession whose navigation recovers from a tab stuck while loading: stop the old load and retry once.
318	    It works in its own `Tab` (set `_tab` before starting), with focus emulation on: with several windows only one has
319	    the OS focus, and in the others typed text and focus-dependent page scripts did nothing (logins "did not register",
320	    links "did not navigate"). Playwright enables the same emulation on every page for this reason."""
321	
322	    _tab: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
323	    _focus_emulated: set = PrivateAttr(default_factory=set)
324	
325	    async def connect(self, cdp_url: str | None = None):
326	        await super().connect(cdp_url)
327	        tab, focus = self._tab, self.agent_focus_target_id
328	        if tab is not None and focus and tab.target_id != focus:
329	            alive = {t.target_id for t in _all_page_targets(self.session_manager)}
330	            if tab.target_id not in alive:      # a main tab's first use, or the agent closed its tab: adopt this one
331	                _OWNERS.pop(tab.target_id or "", None)
332	                tab.popups.discard(focus)
333	                tab.claim(focus)
334	        if tab is not None and focus:
335	            await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(focus, focus=True)     # turns focus emulation on for the tab
336	        return self
337	
338	    async def get_or_create_cdp_session(self, target_id=None, focus: bool = True):
339	        session = await super().get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=focus)
340	        if focus and self._tab is not None:
341	            self._tab.adopt(session.target_id)      # the agent went into a popup of its tab: keep others out
342	        if focus and self._tab is not None and session.session_id not in self._focus_emulated:
343	            self._focus_emulated.add(session.session_id)
344	            try:
345	                await session.cdp_client.send.Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled(
346	                    params={"enabled": True}, session_id=session.session_id)
347	            except Exception as error:
348	                log.debug("focus emulation failed: %s", error)
349	        return session
350	
351	    async def _navigate_and_wait(self, url, target_id, timeout=None, wait_until="load"):
352	        try:
353	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)
354	        except RuntimeError as error:
355	            if "timed out" not in str(error):
356	                raise
357	            log.warning("navigation stuck, stopping the old load and retrying: %s", url)
358	            session = await self.get_or_create_cdp_session(target_id, focus=False)
359	            try:
360	                await asyncio.wait_for(session.cdp_client.send.Page.stopLoading(session_id=session.session_id), 5)
361	            except Exception as stop_error:
362	                log.debug("stopLoading failed: %s", stop_error)
363	            return await super()._navigate_and_wait(url, target_id, timeout=timeout, wait_until=wait_until)

416	async def browse(ctx, goal: str, *, browser: int = 0, tab: Tab | None = None, site_id: str = "", on_record=None,
417	                 max_steps: int = 40, hints: str = "", author: str = "browse", use_vision=False,
418	                 stop_reserve: float | None = None, extra_tools=None, max_actions_per_step: int = 4,
419	                 flash: bool = True) -> dict:
420	    """Run a browser-use agent until done / max_steps / out of time. Returns {"summary", "records", "steps", "done"}.
421	
422	    `tab`: the tab to work in (default: the main tab of `browser`). Screenshots are off by default
423	    (`use_vision=False`): capturing them hung in the sandbox browsers, and `read_page` already reads canvas labels and
424	    hidden text. `flash`: short replies + compact prompt (see module doc). `stop_reserve`: stop when the run has this
425	    many seconds left (default: the SUBMIT reserve). `extra_tools(tools)` may register more actions. Pages read with a
426	    `topic` reach `on_record` as {"kind": "page", "data": {...}}.
427	    """
428	    records: list[dict] = []
429	    reserve = SUBMIT_RESERVE_S if stop_reserve is None else stop_reserve
430	
431	    async def emit(rec: dict) -> None:
432	        records.append(rec)
433	        if on_record:
434	            await on_record(rec)
435	
436	    tools = build_tools(ctx, site_id, author, emit)
437	    if extra_tools:
438	        extra_tools(tools)
439	
440	    tab = tab or main_tab(browser)
441	    await tab.open()
442	    session = make_session(ctx, tab, vision=bool(use_vision))
443	    prompt = dict(flash_mode=True, override_system_message=FLASH_SYSTEM.format(max_actions=max_actions_per_step)) \
444	        if flash else {}
445	    # A tab an agent already worked in is on the site (logged in, past gates): start from its current page instead of
446	    # browser-use opening the site's start URL from the goal again.
447	    reused = tab.used and bool(browsers.cdp_urls())
448	    tab.used = True
449	    agent = Agent(task=goal + ("\n\nThis tab is already on the site: start from the current page." if reused else ""),
450	                  llm=make_llm(flash), browser_session=session, tools=tools, use_vision=use_vision,
451	                  use_judge=False, generate_gif=False, max_failures=6, max_actions_per_step=max_actions_per_step,
452	                  llm_timeout=150, step_timeout=240, directly_open_url=not reused,
453	                  extend_system_message=SYSTEM_EXTRA + (f"\n{hints}" if hints else ""), **prompt)
454	
455	    async def stop_when_out_of_time(_agent) -> None:
456	        if ctx.seconds_left() <= reserve:
457	            agent.stop()
458	
459	    try:
460	        history = await agent.run(max_steps=max_steps, on_step_start=stop_when_out_of_time)
461	    finally:
462	        await session.kill() if not browsers.cdp_urls() else await session.stop()   # never kill the run's browsers
463	    return {"summary": history.final_result() or "", "records": records, "steps": len(history.history),
464	            "done": history.is_done()}

467	def build_tools(ctx, site_id: str, author: str, emit) -> Tools:
468	    """Our actions for the browsing model: record, read_page, fill_form. `emit(rec)` receives records and pages."""
469	    tools = Tools(exclude_actions=list(EXCLUDED_ACTIONS))
470	
471	    @tools.action("Save one fact found (kept even if time runs out).", param_model=RecordParams)
472	    async def record(params: RecordParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
473	        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
474	        await emit({"kind": params.kind, "data": params.data, "source": params.source or url, "note": params.note,
475	                    "site": site_id, "author": author})
476	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=f"recorded {params.kind}")
477	
478	    async def read_one(target: str | None, params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession) -> tuple[str, str]:
479	        if target:
480	            await browser_session.navigate_to(target)
481	            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
482	        url = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
483	        pages = [await read_current_page(browser_session)]
484	        if params.next_page_link:
485	            for _ in range(max(0, min(params.max_pages, 20) - 1)):
486	                if await _evaluate(browser_session, NEXT_JS, params.next_page_link) != "clicked":
487	                    break
488	                await asyncio.sleep(1.2)
489	                text = await read_current_page(browser_session)
490	                if text == pages[-1]:
491	                    break
492	                pages.append(text)
493	        text = "\n\n----- next page -----\n\n".join(pages)
494	        if params.topic:
495	            title = await browser_session.get_current_page_title()
496	            await emit({"kind": "page", "data": {"topic": params.topic, "url": url, "title": title,
497	                                                 "pages": len(pages), "text": text[:10 * PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT]},
498	                        "source": url, "note": "", "site": site_id, "author": author})
499	        return url, text
500	
501	    @tools.action("Read full text of current page (or of `url` / several `urls`) incl. iframes, collapsed sections, "
502	                  "tooltips; `next_page_link` follows all pages; `topic` saves as evidence.", param_model=ReadParams)
503	    async def read_page(params: ReadParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
504	        current = await browser_session.get_current_page_url()
505	        wanted = [u for u in ([params.url] if params.url else []) + list(params.urls or []) if u][:12]
506	        targets = []
507	        for u in wanted:
508	            target = _same_site(u, current, ctx.task)
509	            if not target:
510	                return ActionResult(error=f"{u} is not on this task's websites")
511	            targets.append(target)
512	        reads = []
513	        for target in targets or [None]:
514	            try:
515	                reads.append(await read_one(target, params, browser_session))
516	            except Exception as error:      # one bad page must not lose the others
517	                reads.append((target or current, f"(could not read: {error})"))
518	        limit = PAGE_TEXT_LIMIT // len(reads)
519	        parts, memos = [], []
520	        for url, text in reads:
521	            shown = text if len(text) <= limit else \
522	                text[:limit] + ("\n[... truncated here; the full text is saved]" if params.topic else "\n[... truncated]")
523	            parts.append(f"=== {url}\n{shown}")
524	            memos.append(f"{url} ({len(text)} chars)")
525	        memo = "Read " + ", ".join(memos) + (f"; saved as '{params.topic}'" if params.topic else "")
526	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=memo + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(parts), include_extracted_content_only_once=True,
527	                            long_term_memory=memo[:600])
528	
529	    @tools.action("Fill several form fields on current page at once (by label or name); cascading selects via "
530	                  "`apply_button`; optional `then_click`.", param_model=FillParams)
531	    async def fill_form(params: FillParams, browser_session: BrowserSession):
532	        from swarm.forms import fill_fields
533	        report = await fill_fields(lambda js, *a: _evaluate(browser_session, js, *a),
534	                                   [(f.field, f.value) for f in params.fields], params.apply_button, params.then_click)
535	        return ActionResult(extracted_content=report, include_extracted_content_only_once=True,
536	                            long_term_memory=report[:400])
537	
538	    return tools

"""Requirements of the specification revision marked current, with the tender Q&A's scoped amendments applied.

results["spec"] = {"revisions": [{"revision", "date", "status", "is_current"}], "current": "R-..."}
results["requirements"] = {ref: {"bore", "stroke", "stroke_kind": "nominal"|"usable", "pressure", "mounting",
    "certification", "kataloggruppe", "pieces_per_set", "reserve_key", "revision", "amended": [..]}}
Numbers are plain strings without locale noise (e.g. "200"); stroke is the value after amendments (usable travel if
stroke_kind == "usable"; the matcher adds the end reserves from the technical release mail).
It is written up to three times: early, as soon as a requirement table page is saved (so the ERP search can start
while the spec scraper finishes), then from all spec pages, then with amendments, followed by
results["requirements_final"] = True.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_decimal

SHAPE = """{"revisions": [{"revision": "", "date": "ISO date (mind the stated MM/DD or DD/MM order)", "status": "as shown",
               "is_current": true/false}],
 "requirements": [{"revision": "revision these values belong to", "ref": "requirement reference as shown",
   "bore": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "stroke": "number as shown incl. locale marker",
   "stroke_kind": "nominal, or usable if the stroke is a usable travel (nutzbarer Weg) that needs end reserves",
   "pressure": "number as shown incl. locale marker", "mounting": "", "certification": "",
   "kataloggruppe": "catalogue group to search in the ERP", "pieces_per_set": "pieces per set (Satz) if stated, else null",
   "reserve_key": "technical release / end reserve key if referenced, else null",
   "original_text": "the requirement's original wording if shown"}]}"""

NUMERIC = ("bore", "stroke", "pressure")


def plain_number(text) -> str | None:
    value = to_decimal(text)
    return None if value is None else format(value.normalize(), "f")


def apply_amendments(requirements: dict, current: str, clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Latest dated amendment per (requirement, attribute) that names the current revision; other revisions ignored."""
    fields = {"bore": ("bohrung", "bore", "durchmesser"), "stroke": ("hub", "stroke", "stellweg", "weg"),
              "pressure": ("druck", "pressure"), "mounting": ("befestigung", "mounting"),
              "certification": ("zertifi", "certification", "prüf")}
    amendments = sorted((c for c in clarifications if c.get("amendment")),
                        key=lambda c: to_datetime(c.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
    for c in amendments:
        a = c["amendment"]
        if norm_ref(a.get("revision")) != norm_ref(current):
            continue
        req = requirements.get(next((r for r in requirements if norm_ref(r) == norm_ref(a.get("requirement"))), ""))
        attr = next((f for f, words in fields.items() if any(w in (a.get("attribute") or "").lower() for w in words)), None)
        if req is None or attr is None or a.get("value") in (None, ""):
            continue
        req[attr] = plain_number(a["value"]) if attr in NUMERIC else str(a["value"]).strip()
        req.setdefault("amended", []).append(f"{attr} by Q&A {c.get('number')} ({c.get('date')})")
    return requirements


@register
class RequirementAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT

    async def run(self) -> None:
        early = asyncio.create_task(self.early())
        try:
            await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.spec", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        finally:
            if not early.done():
                early.cancel()
        if not pages(self.ctx, "spec"):
            raise RuntimeError("no specification pages were saved")
        revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
        await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
        self.log.info("current revision %s, requirements %s", current, list(requirements))
        tender = await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        amended = apply_amendments({k: dict(v) for k, v in requirements.items()}, current,
                                   (tender or {}).get("clarifications") or [])
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", amended)
        await self.ctx.board.set("requirements_final", True)

    async def early(self) -> None:
        """As soon as a requirement table is saved, publish a first version so the ERP search can start while the
        spec scraper is still finishing (the final version replaces it)."""
        while True:
            topics = " ".join(str(e.data.get("topic", "")).lower() for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec"))
            if "requirement" in topics or "anforderung" in topics:
                revisions, current, requirements = await self.analyse()
                if requirements and self.ctx.board.get("requirements") is None:
                    await self.ctx.board.set("spec", {"revisions": revisions, "current": current})
                    await self.ctx.board.set("requirements", requirements)
                    self.log.info("early requirements (%s): %s", current, list(requirements))
                return
            await asyncio.sleep(3)

    async def analyse(self) -> tuple[list, str, dict]:
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "spec")]
        out = await extract(self.ctx, "Extract specification's revision list and requirement rows (every revision whose "
                                      "rows are on the pages). Revision current only if its status says so (e.g. "
                                      "gültig/aktuell/current), never if superseded (ersetzt).",
                            SHAPE, blocks, list_key=("requirements", "revisions"))
        revisions = out.get("revisions") or []
        flagged = [r for r in revisions if r.get("is_current") is True]
        flagged.sort(key=lambda r: to_datetime(r.get("date")) or to_datetime("1970-01-01"))
        current = flagged[-1]["revision"] if flagged else ""
        rows = out.get("requirements") or []
        if current:
            rows = [r for r in rows if norm_ref(r.get("revision")) == norm_ref(current)] or rows
        requirements = {}
        for r in rows:
            ref = str(r.get("ref") or "").strip()
            if not ref:
                continue
            entry = {k: r.get(k) for k in ("mounting", "certification", "kataloggruppe", "reserve_key", "original_text")}
            entry |= {k: plain_number(r.get(k)) for k in NUMERIC}
            entry["stroke_kind"] = "usable" if "usable" in str(r.get("stroke_kind") or "").lower() else "nominal"
            entry["pieces_per_set"] = plain_number(r.get("pieces_per_set")) if r.get("pieces_per_set") else None
            entry["revision"] = r.get("revision") or current
            requirements.setdefault(ref, entry)
        return revisions, current, requirements

"""Turns the saved tender pages into positions and Q&A records, then applies the quantity rules in code.

results["tender"] = {
  "meta": {"reference", "deadline", ...},
  "positions": [{"position", "short_text", "quantity" (as shown), "unit", "requirement_ref"}],
  "clarifications": [{"number", "date", "kind", "positions": [...], "new_quantity", "withdraws": [...],
                      "amendment": {...} | null, "keys": {...}, "setup_fee": str | null, "text"}]
}
results["quantities"] = {position: {"quantity": int (in the position's unit), "unit": str, "basis": str}}
Rule: tender quantity, overridden by the latest dated clarification that changes it; withdrawn answers are ignored.
"""
import asyncio

from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.extract import extract, page_block, pages
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, to_datetime, to_int

POSITIONS_SHAPE = """{"meta": {"reference": "", "title": "", "deadline": "", "timezone": ""},
 "positions": [{"position": "position number as shown", "short_text": "", "quantity": "as shown", "unit": "",
                "requirement_ref": "requirement reference as shown"}]}"""

QA_SHAPE = """{"clarifications": [{
  "number": "Q&A number", "date": "UTC ISO timestamp if shown, else as shown", "question": "", "answer": "full answer text",
  "kind": "quantity_change | withdrawal | technical_amendment | commercial_keys | setup_fee | other",
  "positions": ["position numbers this answer applies to"],
  "new_quantity": "new total quantity as shown, or null", "quantity_unit": "unit of that quantity or null",
  "withdraws": ["numbers of earlier answers this one EXPLICITLY withdraws/retracts (zurückgezogen); a newer value replacing an older one is not a withdrawal"],
  "amendment": {"document": "", "revision": "", "requirement": "", "attribute": "", "value": ""} or null,
  "keys": {"konditionsgruppe": null, "packaging_tariff": null, "delivery_key": null, "setup_pool": null, "bonus_plan": null},
  "setup_fee": "one-off setup cost amount as shown, or null"}]}"""


def withdrawn_numbers(clarifications: list[dict]) -> set[str]:
    """Numbers of answers explicitly withdrawn by a withdrawal answer (a newer value is not a withdrawal)."""
    return {norm_ref(n) for c in clarifications if c.get("kind") == "withdrawal" for n in (c.get("withdraws") or [])}


def final_quantities(positions: list[dict], clarifications: list[dict]) -> dict:
    withdrawn = withdrawn_numbers(clarifications)
    out = {}
    for p in positions:
        pos = str(p.get("position") or "").strip()
        if not pos:
            continue
        qty, basis = to_int(p.get("quantity")), "tender"
        changes = [c for c in clarifications
                   if c.get("new_quantity") not in (None, "") and norm_ref(c.get("number")) not in withdrawn
                   and pos in [str(x).strip() for x in (c.get("positions") or [])]]
        changes.sort(key=lambda c: (to_datetime(c.get("date")) is not None, to_datetime(c.get("date")) or 0,
                                    to_int(c.get("number")) or 0))
        if changes:
            latest = changes[-1]
            qty, basis = to_int(latest.get("new_quantity")), f"Q&A {latest.get('number')}"
        out[pos] = {"quantity": qty, "unit": p.get("unit"), "basis": basis}
    return out


@register
class QuantityAnalyzer(Agent):
    phase = Phase.COLLECT        # runs as soon as the tender scraper is done, while the other sites are still read

    async def run(self) -> None:
        await self.ctx.board.wait_for(key="done.tender", timeout=max(1.0, self.ctx.time_left()))
        blocks = [page_block(e) for e in pages(self.ctx, "tender")]
        if not blocks:
            raise RuntimeError("no tender pages were saved")
        ref = (self.ctx.board.get("brief") or {}).get("tender_reference", "")
        pos_out, qa_out = await asyncio.gather(
            extract(self.ctx, "List the tender's positions from the bill of quantities / position overview "
                              "(original tender quantities, not Q&A changes).", POSITIONS_SHAPE, blocks),
            extract(self.ctx, f"List EVERY bidder Q&A entry for tender {ref} (all pages). Classify each answer.",
                    QA_SHAPE, blocks, list_key="clarifications"))
        positions = [p for p in (pos_out or {}).get("positions", []) if p.get("position")]
        seen, clarifications = set(), []
        for c in qa_out.get("clarifications", []):
            key = norm_ref(c.get("number")) or norm_ref(c.get("question"))
            if key and key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                clarifications.append(c)
        tender = {"meta": (pos_out or {}).get("meta", {}), "positions": positions, "clarifications": clarifications}
        await self.ctx.board.set("tender", tender)
        quantities = final_quantities(positions, clarifications)
        await self.ctx.board.set("quantities", quantities)
        self.log.info("%d positions, %d Q&A, quantities %s", len(positions), len(clarifications), quantities)
# OWNER: (name)   ROLE: verifier   NEEDS: all results   WRITES: results["verification"] (and may correct results)
"""Cross-checks before computing: the tender reference (mandatory for eligibility), positions vs quantities vs
materials, and which inputs are missing. Plain code; it never drops positions, it only reports (and fixes the
reference when the brief's and the portal's agree after normalisation).

results["verification"] = {"issues": [str], "reference": str}
"""
from swarm import Agent, Phase, register
from swarm.normalize import norm_ref, strip_invisible


@register
class EvidenceVerifier(Agent):
    phase = Phase.VERIFY

    async def run(self) -> None:
        board, issues = self.ctx.board, []
        brief = dict(board.get("brief") or {})
        tender = board.get("tender") or {}
        portal_ref = strip_invisible((tender.get("meta") or {}).get("reference"))
        ref = strip_invisible(brief.get("tender_reference"))
        if not ref and portal_ref and norm_ref(portal_ref) in norm_ref(self.ctx.brief):
            ref = portal_ref
            issues.append("reference taken from the tender portal (it also occurs in the brief)")
        elif ref and portal_ref and norm_ref(ref) != norm_ref(portal_ref):
            issues.append(f"reference mismatch: brief {ref!r} vs portal {portal_ref!r}; keeping the brief's")
        if not ref:
            issues.append("NO TENDER REFERENCE: the bid would be ineligible")
        brief["tender_reference"] = ref
        await board.set("brief", brief)
        positions = [str(p.get("position")) for p in tender.get("positions") or []]
        quantities, materials = board.get("quantities") or {}, board.get("materials") or {}
        for pos in positions:
            if (quantities.get(pos) or {}).get("quantity") in (None, 0):
                issues.append(f"{pos}: quantity missing")
            if not (materials.get(pos) or {}).get("material"):
                issues.append(f"{pos}: material missing ({(materials.get(pos) or {}).get('reason', 'not analysed')})")
        for key in ("discount", "mail", "erp", "requirements"):
            if board.get(key) is None:
                issues.append(f"{key}: not available")
        await board.set("verification", {"issues": issues, "reference": ref})
        self.log.info("verification: %s", issues)
